title: Azure Oceanfront Villas by Fendi Casa | Luxury Branded Residences
content:
Discover Azure Oceanfront Villas by Fendi Casa, premium luxury residences featuring designer interiors, oceanfront views, world-class amenities, and exclusive branded living. Explore floor plans, pricing, and investment opportunities.
Azure Oceanfront Villas Interiors by Fendi Casa
Azure Oceanfront Villas is a limited collection of five-bedroom residences, suspended 130 meters above the sea, inside AIDA, Oman’s most prestigious gated coastal community. Interiors by FENDI Casa. Nothing in front of you. Nothing above you. Only the horizon.
First row to nature’s beauty. Nineteen pieces above the sea
A gated enclave within a gated community
Azure occupies the highest and most discreet zone within AIDA. Privately gated. Limited in number. Built for distance. Designed for discretion.
Interiors by FENDI Casa
Interiors reflect the brand’s signature approach to craftsmanship and detail, combining refined materials with a contemporary design language. Custom furnishings, sculptural elements, and curated finishes create spaces that are both functional and expressive.
THE VILLAS SPECS
Five-bedroom villas designed with a focus on proportion, functionality, and material quality. Key features include: • Branded interiors by FENDI Casa • Open-plan living and dining areas • Bespoke finishes and materials • Expansive glazing to maximise natural light • Carefully planned layouts for privacy and flow Each villa is composed to balance design clarity with everyday usability.
LIVING EXPERIENCE
Each residence includes private outdoor spaces designed as extensions of the interior. • Expansive terraces • Landscaped gardens • Infinity-edge swimming pools These elements are positioned to create continuity between indoor and outdoor living.
THE VIEWS
All villas are oriented toward the sea, ensuring uninterrupted views of the horizon. There are no structures above or in front, allowing full visual openness and a direct connection to the surrounding landscape.
LOCATION
AIDA is a gated clifftop community overlooking the Gulf of Oman, spanning over 4.3 million sqm. The city integrates residential, golfing, and hospitality components, including: • Trump International Golf Club • Luxury hotels and resorts • Beaches and coastal access • Wellness and outdoor facilities Located approximately 25 minutes from Muscat International Airport, AIDA offers both accessibility and seclusion.

Painite Villas Design Inspired by Automobili Lamborghini
The Painite Villas are luxurious six-bedroom villas located in the south of Spain, featuring exclusive Sky Car Lift technology by Automobili Lamborghini and offering panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea.
SIDE BY SIDE
The Painite Villas are the only villas in the South of Spain with the exclusive Sky Car Lift with technology by Automobili Lamborghini. Located in the hills of Benahavis, overlooking Marbella, the Painite Villas rise out from the hills, offering panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea and the Andalusian landscape. The villas fitted with Automobili Lamborghini interiors have their very own private car elevator. The Sky Car Lift has access to both levels of the villa, seamlessly integrating your supercar into your living space.
PRIVATE SKY CAR LIFT
The entrance to the Painite Villa is nothing short of breathtaking. As you drive into the villa via the Sky Car Lift, you're enveloped in a protective glass dome that offers a stunning 360-degree view of your supercar. Inside, you're greeted by spacious, light-filled interiors where floor-to-ceiling windows seamlessly blend the indoors with the outdoors. Here, your supercar is the centerpiece, showcased like a piece of art against the magnificent backdrop of the Mediterranean Sea.
THE VILLA
The villa boasts six luxurious bedrooms, expansive roof terraces, and panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea from every angle. Complementing this are the extensive swimming pool and lush, meticulously designed gardens, making the villa a gateway to unparalleled luxury.
The Painite Villas are masterfully positioned on the hilltops, where careful leveling ensures that each villa enjoys unobstructed, panoramic views. From this elevated vantage point, the villas offer breathtaking vistas that stretch across the horizon, providing an uninterrupted connection to the surrounding landscape. The strategic placement of these villas maximizes the stunning scenery and creates a sense of serenity and exclusivity.
THE AMENITIES
Each villa features expansive roof terraces that provide an ideal setting for relaxation or entertaining, all while enjoying panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea from every angle. The outdoor space is thoughtfully designed, offering a perfect spot for a pool if desired, and is surrounded by meticulously landscaped luxury gardens that offer a serene escape. Every aspect of these villas is crafted to create a harmonious blend of luxury, comfort, and natural beauty.
The Painite Villas are located in Tierra Viva in Marbella, one of the most affluent locations around the world. Home to the most stylish clubs, restaurants and hotels, as well as, shopping areas, exclusive marinas and breathtaking beaches. The villas are precisely nestled in the hills, only minutes away from the shores and in close proximity to 9 golf clubs, numerous Andalusian villages and Puerto Banus.
FLOOR PLANS

Unlisted are the only two villas in the world fitted with interiors by Pagani. These exquisite villas come with their own private entrance and offer an unmatched level of specifications, in a prime location on the Dubai Canal.
OVERVIEW
Unlisted are the only two villas in the world fitted with interiors by Pagani. These exquisite villas come with their own private entrance and offer an unmatched level of specifications, in a prime location on the Dubai Canal. Here, nothing is left to chance. least of all, privacy.
QUIET STARDOM
The freedom of getting in and out without anyone noticing. The pleasure of walking in your own lobby.
PRIVATE ELEVATOR
A world of discreet liberation, where you can slip into an elevator unnoticed, leaving the world behind as the doors close.
HIGHEST VILLA SPECS IN DUBAI
Every aspect is meticulously perfected with exquisite attention to detail, using only the finest materials in a tastefully harmonious design.
INTIMATE PARADISE
Your private island in the middle of the buzz. This is what it means to have your private pool and terrace directly on the Dubai Canal. First class amenities to be shared only with your closest circle.
HIDE AND SEE
Discover an exceptional fusion of upscale voyeurism and unmatched privacy. The villas sit directly by the Dubai Canal to ensure every moment is ‘to see, and not be seen’. Enjoy exclusive panoramic vistas of the canal and the beautiful surroundings, without a single head turning your way.
NOWHERE ELSE
The villas are inside the only existing tower in the world with interiors designed by iconic hypercar maker Pagani. You are used to live within reach of everything that counts. Here, the Burj Khalifa is right next door, as well as the Dubai Mall, the Dubai Opera and all the most exclusive hotels, restaurants and clubs. [Get in Touch](https://darglobal.co.uk/get-in-touch)
7&8 Albert Hall Mansions
7&8 Albert Hall Mansions Penthouse is situated in one of London’s most prestigious neighborhoods, directly overlooking the iconic Royal Albert Hall. This historic and architecturally significant building offers residents breathtaking views as well as an exclusive address.
COMING SOON
Top Of the Astera
Introducing the Top of the Astera – the world’s first villa in the sky with interiors by Aston Martin. Rising above Al Marjan Island, this masterpiece redefines luxury, offering breathtaking views and unparalleled elegance. Experience the prestige of living above the clouds and beyond the ordinary.
A World First
Beyond the Clouds
This exclusive villa offers direct beach access and stunning front-row views. Designed to blend sky-high sophistication with seaside grandeur, it delivers an extraordinary living experience.
ELEVATE YOUR WORLD
Residents arrive in unmatched style via a private elevator leading directly to their villa. With meticulously designed interiors by Aston Martin, every detail speaks of refined craftsmanship and world-class luxury.
THE LIVING SPACES
Step into a timeless expression of design. The living areas are curated with bespoke furnishings and materials, echoing the signature elegance of Aston Martin’s automotive legacy. Each space is designed to complement your lifestyle, offering both comfort and sophistication.
Nestled on Al Marjan Island, the Top of the Astera offers direct beach access, is minutes away from the Wynn Resort, and just 45 minutes from Dubai International Airport, placing you at the heart of exclusivity and convenience.
THE ALBERT HALL MANSION
Albert Hall Mansions History
Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.
A prestigious Address
The Albert Hall Mansion is situated in one of London’s most prestigious neighborhoods, directly overlooking the iconic Royal Albert Hall. This historic and architecturally significant building offers residents breathtaking views as well as an exclusive address. The location provides the perfect balance between the vibrant energy of city life and the tranquility of a refined residential area.
Albert Hall Mansions is ideally located in one of London's most prestigious neighborhoods, directly overlooking the iconic Royal Albert Hall. This historic building offers breathtaking views and an exclusive address, balancing the vibrant energy of city life with the tranquility of a refined residential area. Situated in South Kensington, residents have access to Hyde Park, the Victoria and Albert Museum, and the luxury shopping of Knightsbridge, along with an array of fine dining, shopping, and cultural attractions. This location is perfect for those seeking a sophisticated and dynamic lifestyle.

The expansive residence extending the entire top floor is accented with the most unique feature of the penthouse, the sphere. A sphere completely constructed with geometric glass panes to give you 360 degree views, from the sweeping Dubai Canal to Downtown Dubai.
ELEVATING THE STANDARDS OF LIVING
Residents and guests arrive at the Pagani Penthouse in its very own personal elevator. After being welcomed inside, advanced domotics are available to respond to their every touch.
A timeless interpretation of automotive art. The living spaces are designed with heritage leather, and luxurious fabrics that are reminiscent to the interiors of a Pagani car.
THE PERSONAL SPACES
Traces of the Italian supercar are steeped in hushed tones of the bedrooms, and en-suite bathrooms. The rooms are reminiscent of the ultra-modern interiors of the Pagani, serene and victorious.
The Pagani Penthouse is perched on The DaVinci Tower, which sits at the heart of Dubai’s cultural district, surrounded by prominent landmarks, such as the Dubai Opera, exhibition centres, design houses, art galleries, and affluent neighbourhoods. This gives you the perfect opportunity to explore various shopping, dining, and cultural experiences by the Dubai Canal, Business Bay and Burj Khalifa. Inspired by the exclusive 5th Avenue penthouse in New York, we are introducing the Only two penthouses that’ll exist in the Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai. Both are duplexes. Both have private pools facing the Burj Khalifa. Each spans two levels with 180° views—from Downtown to the sea. There won’t be a third. This is it.
ONLY TWO. BUILT FOR THE FEW
FOR THOSE WHO NEVER COMPROMISE
Private elevator. Double-height ceilings. Stone, wood, and finishes made to last. No clutter. No noise. Just sharp, clean lines and quiet confidence. This isn’t a showpiece. It’s a standard.
IN THE CENTER. ABOVE IT ALL.
Right on Sheikh Zayed Road. At the edge of Downtown. Easy in. Easy out. No detours. No distractions.

Frequently Asked Questions
What types of properties are available at Amaya?
Amaya is a 1-million-square-meter master-planned community by Dar Global in central Jeddah. In addition to completed villas and custom land plots, Amaya offers townhouses, mid-to-high-rise residential and commercial plots, and branded or serviced residences, including Trump Plaza.
Is Jeddah good for property investment?
Jeddah is one of Saudi Arabia's largest and most active real estate markets, driven by its status as a commercial hub and gateway city on the Red Sea coast. Demand for residential property in Jeddah is supported by a growing population, ongoing infrastructure investment, and ambitious national development plans under Saudi Vision 2030. Villas and land plots, like those offered at
, tend to appeal to buyers seeking long-term ownership and the option to customize their homes. For buyers considering the Gulf Cooperation Council region, Jeddah offers a relatively stable entry point into a maturing property market with room for continued growth.
How much does a villa or plot in Jeddah cost?
Pricing for villas and land plots at
in Jeddah depends on unit size, plot dimensions, and current inventory availability.
has not published a fixed price list for the community, as costs vary based on the specific villa type or plot chosen. Buyers interested in
should reach out directly to DarGlobal or an authorized sales representative to get up-to-date pricing for available units. This approach ensures buyers receive accurate figures reflecting the latest release phase and any applicable offers.
Jeddah vs Riyadh — which is better to buy property?
Amaya sits in a prime central location along King Abdulaziz Road, directly opposite the Red Sea Mall and minutes from the Jeddah Corniche. This gives buyers a coastal lifestyle address with direct connectivity to key urban and historic hubs.
What is the process for buying property in Jeddah?
Amaya offers full freehold ownership options for foreign buyers. Additionally, qualifying real estate investments at Amaya may enable eligible international buyers to apply for the Saudi Premium Residency.
What amenities are near Amaya?
In addition to nearby schools, medical clinics, and mosques, Amaya features signature community amenities. These include a 700-meter central parkland, shaded green walking trails, integrated retail courtyards, and the 4,000-square-meter members-only Vitality Club.
Can I buy a plot at Amaya and build my own villa?
Yes,
offers land plots specifically for buyers who want to design and construct a custom villa rather than purchase a completed home. This option gives buyers greater control over layout, size, and finishing compared to a standard ready-built villa, and it is one of the defining features that sets Amaya apart within
Jeddah offering.
How do I book a plot or villa at Amaya?
Pricing varies by unit type, plot size, and release phase. Prospective buyers should contact Dar Global directly or visit an authorized sales centre to receive up-to-date availability, official price sheets, and reservation guidelines.

Property Ownership
100% ownership of freehold properties for foreign investors.
riyadh, Jeddah ksa
Saudi Arabia is transforming. Socially. Culturally. Economically. Blending rich heritage with ambitious progress. Diversifying its economy and creating an investor-friendly climate. Across the kingdom, from cosmopolitan Riyadh to coastal Jeddah, economic opportunity and real estate demand are rising. So are the returns. DarGlobal is building for this momentum. Crafting developments that celebrate the country’s natural beauty, and embrace its energy of change.
Economic Growth and Stability
SOCIAL AND CULTURAL TRANSFORMATION
The Kingdom is undergoing significant changes under Vision 2030, leading to improvements in lifestyle, entertainment, and overall well-being.
Major cities like Riyadh and Jeddah are rapidly developing modern healthcare facilities, educational institutions, and recreational amenities.
A FLOURISHING REAL ESTATE MARKET
Investors Can Now Bank in Saudi on a Visit Visa
Saudi banks are progressing with preparations to allow temporary account openings for potential investors, holding a valid visit visa ID. Most banks are now offering temporary accounts for the legal use of visitors during their stay.
Government Support
$1.15 trillion Public Investment Fund (PIF) world’s 4th largest sovereign wealth funds. This fuels $1T+ investment in real estate via NEOM, ROSHN, and urban hubs, delivering high-yield residential, commercial, and tourism assets with 100% foreign ownership and 6–9% rental returns.
Investor-Friendly Policies
0% income tax. 100% foreign ownership in designated zones (per new 2025 Investment Law). Stronger investor protections and streamlined dispute resolutions via arbitration and mediation.
Favourable Investor Framework
The Updated Investment Law (Feb 2025) provides equal treatment for local and foreign investors, streamlining licensing, reducing barriers and strengthening protections for investors.
Easy REIT Fund Access
Saudi Arabia’s Capital Market Authority (CMA) has approved reforms to real estate investment trusts (REITs), making it easier for developers to access capital and reducing risk for investors.
Speculation-Curbing Incentives
New White Land Tax (May 2025) imposes fees on undeveloped/vacant properties thus incentivizing swift development and curbing speculation – this freeing up land for investor-led residential and commercial builds.
A CULTURAL HUB
Saudi Arabia boasts a rich cultural heritage with 28,202 historic sites and over 34,171 cultural sites. The country is home to 6 UNESCO world heritage sites, attracting millions of visitors. Seasonal entertainment events draw over 20 million visitors, contributing to the Kingdom's goal of attracting more than 150 million tourists by 2030.

Economic Transformation
Vision 2030 is driving unprecedented growth and diversification in Saudi Arabia, reducing oil dependency and expanding into new sectors.
Business-Friendly Reforms
The Kingdom has implemented reforms including 100% foreign ownership in many sectors, creating a fertile environment for investors.
Young, Educated Population
Saudi Arabia boasts a young, educated workforce committed to innovation, positioning the country to become a leading global business hub.
A STABLE ECONOMY
$1.09 trillion GDP (2024): Largest economy in the Middle East, 19th globally. Vision 2030 Impact: Non-oil sectors now contribute 52% to GDP.
Financial Stability
913 billion in Assets (2024). Sovereign Wealth Fund projected to manage $2.67 trillion in assets by 2030. Low Inflation: Stable inflation rate of 2% in 2024.
Investment Attraction
$31.7 billion in FDI (2024). FDI Growth: Attracted SAR 96 ($25.6) billion in FDI in 2023. Tax Incentives: 30-year corporate tax exemption for regional HQs.
Infrastructure and Economic Environment
Saudi Arabia is investing heavily in infrastructure with new cities, airports, and transportation networks like the Riyadh Metro spanning 176 km and NEOM, a $500 billion futuristic city with $50 billion in foundational works by 2025, creating a modern, efficient investment hub.
Business Environment
The country offers a stable, secure business environment with robust government support and a 2025 Investment Law ensuring equal treatment for investors. Foreign firms setting up regional headquarters benefit from a 30-year corporate tax exemption.
High Returns
With high demand and limited supply, luxury real estate in Saudi Arabia delivers up to 8-9% rental yields, driven by Vision 2030 projects and expatriate growth.
Booming Wealth
Saudi Arabia’s growing number of wealthy individuals, with 2,400 HNWIs expected in 2025, fuels demand for luxury real estate, creating lucrative opportunities.
A YOUNG AND URBANIZED POPULATION
Education Investment
Significant investments in world-class universities and research institutions, such as KAUST and Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University.
STEM Focus
Growing emphasis on STEM education, creating a skilled workforce equipped for a modern economy.
Female Workforce
Significant increase in female workforce participation, growing to over 36% by 2024.
Entrepreneurship
Over 63% of the population is under 30. Rising entrepreneurship programs, supported by government initiatives like Monsha’at for SMEs. The Kingdom is also attracting global talent through initiatives like the Premium Residency (Green Card) Program and fostering a culture of innovation in tech-driven sectors like fintech, AI, and renewable energy.
Best Cities to Invest
riyadh
The capital city and business hub. Riyadh is home to several major infrastructure projects, including the King Abdullah Financial District.
jeddah
Known as the “Gateway to Mecca,” Jeddah attracts millions of pilgrims. It is also a major port city with significant investments in waterfront developments.
Residency Benefits
Up to 8% ROI
Invest in a property with the potential to earn 6 to 8% rental yields annually, offering a strong return on investment.
4M SAR
Investing in residential properties worth at least 4 million Saudi Riyals ($1.07M)grants exclusive residency rights and access to premium services.
New 2026 Foreign Ownership Law
Saudi Arabia's new Law on Real Estate Ownership by Non-Saudis (effective Jan 2026) allows foreign individuals and companies to own property in designated zones like Riyadh and Jeddah, which was previously restricted.

Project marks DarGlobal’s entry into the Qatari market Inspired by the sea and luxury island living, Les Vagues residences embody the sophisticated elegance of ELIE SAAB designs  _______________________ Riyadh, KSA; 17 March 2022: Les Vagues residences by ELIE SAAB were unveiled by DarGlobal, the leading real-estate company in Saudi Arabia, during an exclusive event held in Doha, Qatar in collaboration with Qetaifan Projects, a leading Qatari real estate development company fully owned by Katara Hospitality. The exclusive residences by the world-renowned designer reflect the sophisticated elegance and exceptional detailing that ELIE SAAB is recognized for in fashion and lifestyle, setting new standards for modern luxury living in Qatar. Taking inspiration from the unimaginable beauty and serenity of the sea, grand shores, and infinite horizons surrounding Qetaifan Island North, Les Vagues, which means waves in French, have been exquisitely designed as an ode to luxury island life with clean and contemporary lines softened by carefully selected palms and tropical foliage. Ziad El Chaar, Vice Chairman of DarGlobal Properties, said: “After our successful project launch with the master of design himself, Elie Saab, in Riyadh we’re collaborating for a second time on a premium residential project in one of the region’s most sought-after developments. Our project on Qetaifan Island North is unique and builds on the DarGlobal’s strategic aspirations of regional and global expansion through superior, high-quality real-estate projects that cater to discerning clientele from across the world.” Elie Saab Jr, CEO of ELIE SAAB Group, commented: “We are delighted to collaborate with DarGlobal and Qetaifan Projects on this premium residential project that is inspired by the natural beauty of the island and its magnificent surroundings. Les Vagues is a project that embodies architectural and lifestyle expression of our brand delivering exceptional and timeless experiences through luxury real-estate projects that are unmatched globally.” HE Sheikh Nasser Bin Abdulrahman Al-Thani, Managing Director, Qetaifan Projects, said: “Following our concerted efforts to provide the local market with international standards that work on developing and revitalizing sectors such as tourism, hospitality, entertainment and of course real estate development, we are happy to bring a new innovative project to Qatar. Qetaifan Island North is being developed as the first touristic entertainment destination in Qatar, that will put the country on the regional and global tourism map, and Les Vagues residences is an integral project within the masterplan of the development.”  Les Vagues feature 70 opulent one, two and three-bedroom sea-front residencies with a variety of majestic balconies and terraces and floor-to ceiling windows for residents to enjoy uninterrupted panoramic views of the sea. The interiors perfectly embody the beauty of ELIE SAAB’s designs leaving a lasting impression of refined elegance and spectacular grace where shapes and colors blend harmoniously. Special attention has been given to the finishes with exquisite craftsmanship, exceptional level of quality and aesthetic appeal in pure ELIE SAAB style. The amenities at Les Vagues are tailored to the residents’ needs featuring a la carte concierge services as well as, a state-of-the-art fitness center, an infinity swimming pool, landscaped community courtyard with sea views, 24hrs reception desk, public areas furniture from ELIE SAAB Maison Collection, luxury retail outlets and parking for all residential units. The project marks DarGlobal’s first entry into Qatar with the aim of driving the development of the luxury property market and support the growth of Qatar’s real-estate sector. Work on the development will start in Q2 2022 and total sales are expected to reach over 1 billion Qatari Riyal. Qetaifan Island North is emerging as a thriving waterfront hub representing a new, modern lifestyle. Inspired by the rich culture and nature of the region, the distinct island will feature a thrilling waterpark, a luxurious hotel, unrivalled accommodation, exceptional retail options, and world class facilities that make it a vibrant and attractive community. The island is also a symbol of the vision, insight, and aspiration to develop into an internationally acclaimed and recognized landmark location and Qatar’s future iconic destination.

DarGlobal Appoints Ene Construccion Amaz SL as Main Contractor for Tierra Viva – A Luxury Villa Development with Design Inspired by Automobili Lamborghini
DarGlobal , the London-listed luxury real estate developer, has appointed M/s ENE Construccion Amaz SL as the main works contractor for Tierra Viva, its signature residential project nestled in the hills of Benahavís on Spain’s Costa del Sol.  The appointment marks the start of full-scale construction on one of Southern Europe’s most exclusive villa communities, with architectural design inspired by the iconic Automobili Lamborghini. Tierra Viva is a private gated enclave comprising a limited collection of ultra-luxury villas , each positioned at a unique elevation to capture uninterrupted views of the Mediterranean Sea. Located just minutes from Marbella, the development combines bold architectural language with a refined lifestyle offering, echoing the precision, performance, and power long associated with the Lamborghini name. Each villa, ranging from 4 to 6 bedrooms and spanning up to 1,450 sqm, is meticulously designed to offer a seamless indoor-outdoor experience, featuring private pools, saunas, car lifts, and expansive terraces. ENE Construccion Amaz SL was selected for its technical excellence and its strong reputation in delivering upscale residential projects across Spain. Their appointment reinforces DarGlobal’s commitment to quality and precision as Tierra Viva moves into its main construction phase. Expected to be completed in December 2027, Tierra Viva represents DarGlobal’s first residential venture in continental Europe and a continuation of the company’s strategy to develop world-class properties in iconic destinations.
Dar Global advances construction at Tierra Viva, its first European luxury development with Automobili Lamborghini
Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, has commenced infrastructure works for Tierra Viva, its first residential project in continental Europe in collaboration with Automobili Lamborghini. Tierra Viva is situated in the exclusive locality of Benahavis near Marbella, on Spain's south coast, and features 53 grand villas inspired by Lamborghini's iconic design. This partnership blends Dar Global's expertise in luxury real estate with Lamborghini's renowned design prowess, promising an unparalleled living experience. With the start of the infrastructure work, Dar Global is making real progress towards delivering its distinguished luxury development on time and with the highest standards of quality and competency to maximise long-term value for investors. Sacyr Construction, one of Spain's leading construction companies, has been awarded the contract to design and build infrastructural works, including laying road, water, and electricity networks around the residential project. Sacyr Construction will also be responsible for developing the surrounding road network. Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, said: “We are excited to partner with Sacyr Construction, recognised for their expertise and experience in delivering high-quality infrastructure projects, as we embark on developing the next phase of Tierra Viva, the architectural crown in our luxury real estate portfolio. Working with best-in-class partners adds value to our highly-anticipated residential property as we bring the future of luxury living to an affluent global clientele in Spain. Tierra Viva's design language pays homage to Automobili Lamborghini, marking the brand’s first residential project in Europe that guarantees residents a unique and high-quality lifestyle experience.” Following the launch of Tierra Viva in June last year, Dar Global announced the project’s progression into the construction phase in December. A one-of-kind development, it exemplifies the real estate brand’s unwavering dedication to providing exceptional investment opportunities in the luxury second home market. Set in the heart of the breathtaking Andalusian hills, each of Tierra Viva’s villas is situated at varied elevations, offering residents endless panoramas of the Mediterranean Sea. The community includes three villa designs: Diamante (6-bedroom), Zafiro (5-bedroom), and Esmeralda (4-bedroom). Each villa features direct car access, panoramic swimming pools, multiple terraces, and flourishing gardens, all embellished with polished marble floors, fine leather, and glass elements. The properties’ strategic location in tranquil Benahavis gives residents access to various landmarks, including the beach, Marbella Club Golf Resort, Puerto Banús, Marbella Club Golden Mile, and the Marbella Marina.
Exceptional Luxury Living Redefined: DarGlobal And AUTOMOBILI LAMBORGHINI Present TIERRA VIVA VILLAS in the Highly Exclusive BENAHAVIS
21st June 2023: Prestigious luxury real estate developer DarGlobal unveils its latest and most distinguished project, Tierra Viva. This architectural jewel is set within the ultra-exclusive area of Benahavis, a mere 8-minute drive from the stunning Marbella. The launch of Tierra Viva represents a noteworthy landmark in DarGlobal’s relentless pursuit to deliver incomparable investment opportunities in the luxury segment; the project is valued at approximately 282 million euros.  An exclusive community with 24/7 premium security, Tierra Viva sits within the gated community of Los Jararillos which hosts 2 gate houses and 24/7 premium security, providing a private and secure environment for its residents and guests. It is home to an array of individual grand villas with panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea that harmoniously blend strength and vitality – a fitting tribute to its name. This architectural gem, inspired by the iconic design of Automobili Lamborghini, marks a significant milestone as the first residential project in Europe with the super sports car brand. Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, expressed his pride in the property’s exclusivity, “Tierra Viva represents more than just an exclusive community; it is an emblem of luxury living. At DarGlobal, we have always sought to present the limited-edition of luxury real estate to our discerning clientele. We are delighted to collaborate with Automobili Lamborghini, further broadening our array of luxury brands and delivering the top-tier experience to Spain.” In the heart of the breathtaking Andalusian hills, every villa is situated at varied elevations, offering residents endless panoramas of the Mediterranean Sea. The community includes three villa designs: Diamante (6-bedroom) , Zafiro (5-bedroom), and Esmeralda (4-bedroom) . Each villa features direct car access, panoramic swimming pools, multiple terraces, and flourishing gardens, all embellished with polished marble floors, fine leather, and glass elements. DarGlobal’s alliance with Automobili Lamborghini is an exciting venture. Stephan Winkelmann, CEO of Automobili Lamborghini , remarked, “This partnership represents the merging of Lamborghini’s luxury super sports car essence and DarGlobal’s proficiency in real estate. Tierra Viva embodies the core and power of Lamborghini and its unrestricted nature, interpreted into an architectural masterpiece.” Benahavis, renowned for its exceptional exclusivity and tranquillity, welcomes this unique property. Its strategic location offers residents effortless access to various landmarks, including the beach, Marbella Club Golf Resort, Puerto Banús, Marbella Club Golden Mile, and the Marbella Marina. DarGlobal invites you to witness the extraordinary with Tierra Viva – an epitome of luxury, exclusivity, and architectural innovation. DarGlobal Awards Main Works Contract for ‘The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin’ to Gulf Asia Contracting LLC
DarGlobal, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, proudly announces that Gulf Asia Contracting LLC (GAC), a renowned General Contractor in the GCC with extensive industry experience and ongoing operations in the region, has been awarded the main works contract for its prestigious 'The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin' project. The total contract value for the main works package is AED 201,462,000.00. This significant award marks a pivotal milestone in the development of 'The Astera,' which has a Gross Development Value of AED900 million (£200 million) and represents Aston Martin's inaugural venture into interior design for a real estate development in the Middle East. Set on the picturesque Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah, 'The Astera' will feature a mix of luxury apartments and villas, seamlessly blending Aston Martin’s signature design aesthetics with DarGlobal’s unwavering commitment to offering exceptional living experiences. Gulf Asia Contracting LLC's scope of work will encompass the comprehensive construction of the entire development, from superstructure to finishes, ensuring the highest standards of quality, craftsmanship, and timely delivery. Their proven expertise and extensive regional experience will be instrumental in bringing the iconic design and luxurious vision of 'The Astera' to life. Following the successful completion of the shoring, excavation, and piling works by Stromek Emirates Foundations, the commencement of the main works signifies a major acceleration in the project's construction phase. This appointment is a key step towards realizing 'The Astera' as a landmark development on the Arabian Sea, combining iconic British design with cutting-edge engineering and craftsmanship, and elevating the living experience for future residents.
DarGlobal announces partnership with Aston Martin to deliver stunning beachfront residences in Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates
Partnership will be Aston Martin’s first real estate collaboration in the Gulf Cooperation Council (‘GCC’) Iconic British marque’s design team to create ultra-luxury interiors for a new, exquisite beachfront development on Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah. Agreement further outlines Al Marjan Island’s emergence as a leading luxury destination. DarGlobal, the London listed luxury international real estate developer, has announced a new partnership with Aston Martin. The collaboration will see the British ultra-luxury marque carefully craft interiors for an exquisite beachfront residential development in Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates. To be officially unveiled in May, the new development will be situated on the majestic Al Marjan Island. It is the first time Aston Martin’s internationally acclaimed design team has applied its renown to a real estate project in the GCC, building on successful brand collaborations in the United States and Japan. To be strategically positioned on a pristine location near the highly anticipated Wynn Resort, the new residence, with interiors by Aston Martin, promises to bring the illustrious car marker’s signature blend of sophistication, elegance and high-performance to the property. Providing a unique fusion of luxury living and natural coastal beauty. The accompanying private beach gives way to scenic walking tracks and lush green spaces, with the bright lights of Dubai just an hour away.  With a GDV of approximately US$250 million, the project is expected to be officially unveiled in May 2024 with construction due to be completed in 2028, in joint development with Aarvees Group. With its exceptional natural beauty and world-class amenities, Al Marjan Island continues to attract discerning investors and residents seeking a luxurious lifestyle. The upcoming branded residences with interiors by Aston Martin promise to redefine luxury living in Ras Al Khaimah, setting a new standard of excellence in the region’s real estate landscape. Arch. Abdulla Al Abdouli, CEO of Marjan, commented:  "The introduction of a residence with interiors by Aston Martin on Al Marjan Island further enhances the appeal of our premier destination. This partnership reflects our commitment to delivering unparalleled experiences and reinforces Ras Al Khaimah's position as a leading real estate hub in the region." Stefano Saporetti, Director of Brand Diversification at Aston Martin, commented:  “The partnership between Aston Martin and Dar Global brings together two ultra-luxury lifestyle organisations with a shared passion for combining traditional craftsmanship with innovation and cutting-edge design. Marking Aston Martin’s very first real estate collaboration in the GCC, we are incredibly proud to have the opportunity to design ultra-luxury interiors for what we believe will be an unparalleled development in the emerging luxury destination of Al Marjan Island.” Ziad El Chaar, CEO of DarGlobal, commented : "Our collaboration with Aston Martin marks a significant milestone for Dar Global as we expand our footprint into Ras Al Khaimah. With a track record of delivering iconic properties, we are committed to setting new standards of luxury living in this vibrant emirate.’’ Rajat Verma, President of Aarvees Group, commented:  “As Ras Al Khaimah rightfully solidifies its destination appeal amid local and international investors, we are excited to contribute to its growth momentum alongside Dar Global, a visionary brand that is upending the global real estate market. With our joint expertise in luxury developments, we look forward to delivering a truly splendid lifestyle for our valued customers with this new project on Al Marjan Island. Stay tuned for more updates on this prestigious collaboration between Aston Martin and Dar Global as we unveil further details of this remarkable residential project.
Dar Global Kicks Off Construction at The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin, with the Appointment of Stromek
United Arab Emirates — Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, proudly announces that Stromek Emirates Foundations, a leading engineering and construction firm renowned for delivering high-quality foundational work across the region, has been awarded the contract for shoring, excavation, and piling works for its prestigious 'The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin' project. With a Gross Development Value of Dh900 million (£200 million), 'The Astera' marks Aston Martin's first venture into interior design for a real estate development in the Middle East. Set on the picturesque Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah, the project will feature a mix of luxury apartments and villas, blending Aston Martin’s signature design aesthetics with Dar Global’s commitment to offering exceptional living experiences.  Stromek’s scope of work will focus on ensuring the stability and sustainability of the development's foundational elements. The firm's expertise will play a critical role in preparing the site for construction, ensuring that the project can proceed smoothly while adhering to the highest standards of safety and precision. “We are thrilled to have Stromek on board for this pivotal phase of 'The Astera' project. Their proven track record of excellence in shoring, excavation, and piling work perfectly aligns with the standards we uphold at Dar Global,” said Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global . “This collaboration underscores our commitment to working with the best in the industry to deliver world-class luxury developments that will leave a lasting impact.” The shoring, excavation, and piling works are expected to commence immediately, laying the foundation for what will soon be a landmark development on the Arabian Sea. Stromek’s appointment is a key milestone in the progress of 'The Astera,' a development that will combine iconic British design with cutting-edge engineering and craftsmanship, elevating the living experience for future residents.
Dar Global Introduces Stunning Beach Residence The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin
Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer today unveils ‘ The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin ’¸ an exquisite new beachfront residential development bringing Aston Martin’s renown for ultra-luxury interior design to the highly desirable Al Marjan islands in Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates. With a total Gross Development Value of 900 million UAE Dirhams (c.£200 million), the project is the first time Aston Martin’s internationally acclaimed design team has applied its skills to a real estate development in the Middle East region, with the new luxury lifestyle destination building on the successful recent opening of the Aston Martin Residences in Miami and other high-profile design collaborations in the United States and Japan. Positioned in a pristine location near the highly anticipated Wynn Resort, The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin will bring the carmaker’s signature blend of sophisticated design and high-performance precision craftsmanship to the interiors of the property, promising an unrivalled lifestyle experience for distinguished residents. Due to be completed by December 2028, the waterfront property will become a new landmark on the Arabian Sea for admirers of the iconic sports car marque, as well as those with an appreciation for its unique design philosophy and commitment to craft. Providing the benefits of a secluded private beach, the development will offer expansive, one, two and three bedroom apartments and three bedroom villas. Infused with the spirit of British ingenuity, The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin seeks to create a seamless fusion of bespoke style, cutting-edge materials, meticulous artistry, and unparalleled functionality, with an ambition of becoming one of the world’s most desirable beachfront residences. Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, said: "The launch of this much-awaited residential property, The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin, on Al Marjan Island, furthers our brand vision to curate breathtaking living experience for our exclusive clientele. “Combining this iconic British marque’s heritage, innovation and design mastery with Dar Global’s expertise in providing exceptional investment opportunities through luxury homes for global citizens demonstrates yet another illustrious chapter in our trajectory to success.” Stefano Saporetti, Director of Brand Diversification at Aston Martin, commented: “The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin celebrates our partnership with Dar Global, bringing together two ultra-luxury lifestyle organisations with a shared passion for combining traditional craftsmanship with innovation and cutting-edge design. “Marking Aston Martin’s very first real estate collaboration in the Middle East, we are incredibly excited by the emerging luxury destination of Al Marjan Island. The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin provides an opportunity for our talented designers to help shape the interiors of an unparalleled development in the region, further elevating Aston Martin’s brand and applying it to a beachfront lifestyle environment.” The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin offers residents an independent positioning and ultimate tranquillity on the majestic Al Marjan island, a refuge embraced by azure waters and serene landscapes, away from the hustle and bustle of the city. The island offers a unique setting seamlessly blending seclusion with convenience, with Dubai located just an hour’s drive away. Masterfully designed to harmonise with its surrounding, the new address offers residents a range of world-class amenities including access to a private beach, an infinity pool with magnificent ocean views, a scenic walk track and lush, green communal spaces. An indoor cinema, fitness centre, children’s play area, spa, yoga lawn and multipurpose hall provide additional comforts.

Who developed The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin?
The Astera is developed by DarGlobal in partnership with Aston Martin, marking the British marque's first real estate collaboration in the GCC (Gulf Cooperation Council).

The development offers one, two and three-bedroom apartments alongside three-bedroom villas, each finished with Aston Martin's signature interior design.

Yes. The Astera marks Aston Martin's first real estate collaboration in the GCC (Gulf Cooperation Council), following earlier design partnerships in the United States and Japan.

Construction is underway following the appointment of Stromek Emirates Foundations for shoring, excavation and piling works, with completion due by December 2028.

Residents have access to a private beach, an infinity pool with ocean views, a scenic walking track, an indoor cinema, a fitness centre, a spa, a yoga lawn, a children's play area and a multipurpose hall.

Aston Martin's design team applies the marque's signature blend of sophistication, precision craftsmanship and high-performance design language to every residence's interior.
How far is The Astera from Dubai?
Dubai is approximately an hour's drive from Al Marjan Island, keeping The Astera close to the city while offering a secluded beachfront setting.
Can international buyers obtain UAE residency by purchasing at The Astera?
Buyers investing AED 2 million or more qualify for the UAE's 10-year Golden Visa, and the UAE applies 0% income tax and 0% property tax.

15 September 2023: Missoni and Dar Global, an international real estate development company, have announced the launch of “Marea, interiors by Missoni”, an exclusive residential development project near the Finca Cortesin hotel and golf club, a short walk from the center of Marbella and from the marinas of Puerto Banuìs and Sotogrande, in southern Spain. The project, curated by the creative director of the Missoni home collection Alberto Caliri with the supervision of Rosita Missoni, represents the second partnership between the brand and Dar Global and involves the construction of a real estate complex of 18,500 square meters with two, three and four apartments rooms. The co-ownership, fenced and equipped with premium security services, will also offer a state-of-the-art gym, an infinity pool, a tennis court and play areas dedicated to children. “We are delighted to collaborate with Dar Global on the Marea real estate project, interiors by Missoni, and are thrilled to furnish these incredible apartments with the finest fabrics and design, which will give the Mediterranean residences a unique and original finish. Our creative team came together to design bespoke luxury interiors that perfectly fit into the natural environment surrounding the apartments,” said Livio Proli, CEO of Missoni. Marea, interiors by Missoni is the second project by Dar Global launched in Spain in the last three months, after the ultra luxury villas in Tierra Viva and Benahavis, in June this year. “We are thrilled to partner with world-renowned fashion brand Missoni and offer exclusive homes in the beautiful landscape of southern Spain. The project has something in store for everyone: from the splendor of the unforgettable golf course of Finca Cortesin, to the golden beaches and dunes of Estepona, all against the backdrop of a breathtaking Mediterranean. DarGlobal teams with Missoni to deliver the exclusive Urban Oasis water-front residential tower in Dubai
Urban Oasis by Missoni brings the Missoni lifestyle and Miami vibes to the city The AED 800 million tower is situated in the heart of the city on the Dubai Water Canal _______________________ Riyadh, KSA; October 6, 2021: DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, has unveiled the Urban Oasis residential tower in Dubai in partnership with the luxury Italian fashion house, Missoni, known for its bold colours and iconic zigzag motifs, stripes, and wave patterns. The launch of the prestigious AED 800 million development marks two significant firsts for both the companies: DarGlobal’s regional expansion with its first project in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), and the Arab world’s first ever bespoke Missoni-inspired living spaces designed by the fashion brand’s MissoniHome line dedicated to interiors, decor, and furnishings. Urban Oasis is situated in the heart of the city directly on the Dubai Water Canal in close proximity to Downtown Dubai’s top attractions such as Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall, and many other premium lifestyle locations. The deluxe homes of Urban Oasis offer spectacular and uninterrupted views of the Dubai Water Canal, making the tower a true urban oasis within the bustling city. Construction of the tower is currently underway and is set to be completed before the end of 2023. Ziad El Chaar, Vice Chairman of DarGlobal Real Estate Development Company, said: “The project’s location is in one of the most sought-after in the city, and we’re happy to have our first flagship development in the UAE situated in the heart of Dubai. The Dubai Water Canal is one of Dubai’s most attractive areas for homebuyers, and given its proximity to Downtown Dubai, Urban Oasis assures the best that the city life can offer, making it the ideal place to live. Working with Missoni is a clear indication of our continued dedication to providing our clients and investors with the highest standards of luxury living, while being completely unique compared to anything else on the market.” Livio Proli, CEO, Missoni, said: “We’re delighted to be working with DarGlobal on the Urban Oasis project, our first in the region, and are excited to be furnishing these incredible apartments with the finest fabrics and Miami inspired design, which will give the homes a unique and original finish. Our creative team has come together to design bespoke luxury interiors that perfectly complement the apartment’s urban surroundings. The Dubai real estate sector continues to grow and we’re relishing being a part of a development that has so much to offer.” The stunning Urban Oasis in collaboration with Missoni is one of the best representatives of Italian fashion and contemporary design excellence around the world. It consists of 38 floors of high-end one, two and three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom penthouses with luxury interiors from MissoniHome. The unique penthouse apartments, which are accessible via a private elevator, come fully fitted with high-end Missoni fixtures and décor elements. The immaculately designed one, two, three apartments come in varying sizes and offer unique levels of five-star living, increadible water-front views and a closed kitchen. Residents will also have access to luxury facilities and services. The tower features a swimming pool, a children’s play area, car parking, an equipped gymnasium, and 24/7 conceirge and security service. Expanding the DarGlobal brand to international markets as a testament to the success of Saudi companies in delivering unique projects in new markets. It comes at an opportune time with Expo 2020 starting in October 2021, which will underline the investment potential in Dubai.
