title: DarGlobal commences construction of the sold-out W Residences in Downtown Dubai
content:
DarGlobal is commencing the construction works including the excavation, shoring, and pilling works, 90 days after the successful launch of the W Hotels brand.
DarGlobal commences construction of the sold-out W Residences in Downtown Dubai
Riyadh, KSA; 7 June 2022: DarGlobal is commencing the construction works including the excavation, shoring, and pilling works, 90 days after the successful launch of the W Hotels brand.   W Residences Dubai – Downtown project in February 2022. The already sold-out 1 billion AED development is anticipated to mark the first standalone residences in the world under the iconic lifestyle W Hotels brand. The developer signed a contract with Stromek Emirates Foundations (L.L.C) to execute the shoring, excavation and piling works. BHNS Engineering Consultants is the Architect of Records appointed by DarGlobal and will supervise the construction of the enabling package.  Ziad El Chaar, Vice Chairman of DarGlobal Properties, said: “Construction of The W Residences Dubai – Downtown is estimated to be completed by December 2025. This our third project in the Downtown Dubai area after Urban Oasis with Interiors by Missoni and DaVinci Tower with interiors by Pagani and I believe it’s a unique and fulfilling location to own your dream W branded home and our proposition catering to the needs of discerning clientele. Our experience in delivering high-end co-branded homes with global brands like Elie Saab, Versace, Roberto Cavalli, Pagani and Missoni puts us in a unique position to always bring the best, most desirable residential spaces to our customers. Expanding the DarGlobal brand to international markets is a testament to the success of Saudi companies in delivering unique projects in new markets. The developer is one of the largest publicly listed developers in the Middle East with AED 32 billion in assets and a track record of delivery since 1994. The Residences are 20 mins away from Dubai International Airport, 10 minutes from the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) and a few minutes away from The Dubai Mall, one of the world’s largest shopping malls.

title: DarGlobal tops out its Urban Oasis by Missoni residential tower in Dubai at 34 stories
content:
Urban Oasis by Missoni brings the Missoni lifestyle and Miami vibes to the city The AED 800 million tower is situated in the heart of the city on the Dubai Water Canal.
DarGlobal tops out its Urban Oasis by Missoni residential tower in Dubai at 34 stories
Urban Oasis by Missoni brings the Missoni lifestyle and Miami vibes to the city The AED 800 million tower is situated in the heart of the city on the Dubai Water Canal. _______________________ Riyadh, KSA; April 12, 2021: DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, is celebrating the significant milestone of topping out its Urban Oasis residential tower in partnership with the luxury Italian fashion house, Missoni, at 34 stories. The structural completion milestone was celebrated by the company’s Chairman, Yousef Al Shelash, as he visited site and participated in the topping out ceremony. Worth AED 800 million, Urban Oasis is currently 80% sold to a diverse range of homeowners and investors from all over the world representing over 45 nationalities. The tower is DarGlobal’s first project in the United Arab Emirates, and the region’s first ever bespoke Missoni-inspired living spaces designed by the fashion brand’s MissoniHome line dedicated to interiors, decor, and furnishings. Urban Oasis is situated in the heart of the city directly on the Dubai Water Canal in close proximity to Downtown Dubai’s top attractions such as Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall, and many other premium lifestyle locations. The deluxe homes of Urban Oasis offer spectacular and uninterrupted views of the Dubai Water Canal, making the tower a true urban oasis within the bustling city. The tower set to be completed before the end of 2023. The stunning Urban Oasis in collaboration with Missoni is one of the best representatives of Italian fashion and contemporary design excellence around the world. It consists of high-end one, two and three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom penthouses with luxury interiors from MissoniHome. The unique penthouse apartments, which are accessible via a private elevator, come fully fitted with high-end Missoni fixtures and décor elements. The immaculately designed one, two, three apartments come in varying sizes and offer unique levels of five-star living, incredible water-front views and a closed kitchen. Residents will also have access to luxury facilities and services. The tower features a swimming pool, a children’s play area, car parking, an equipped gymnasium, and 24/7 conceirge and security service.

title: DarGlobal and OMRAN Group announce partnership to develop ‘AIDA’ overlooking the Sea of Oman
content:
DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia and the GCC, and Oman Tourism Development Company (OMRAN Group) – the executive arm of the Sultanate for tourism development, have signed an agreement recently at Expo 2020 Dubai to develop ‘AIDA’, one of the largest premium, mixed-use real estate projects located in the Yiti area in Muscat.
DarGlobal and OMRAN Group announce partnership to develop ‘AIDA’ overlooking the Sea of Oman
Project marks DarGlobal’s entry into the growing Omani market AIDA is an ode to the glorious Sea of Oman and undisturbed nature, where high curvaceous cliffs flawlessly meet deep waters _______________________ Dubai, UAE; March 24, 2022: DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia and the GCC, and Oman Tourism Development Company (OMRAN Group) – the executive arm of the Sultanate for tourism development, have signed an agreement recently at Expo 2020 Dubai to develop ‘AIDA’, one of the largest premium, mixed-use real estate projects located in the Yiti area in Muscat. The project marks DarGlobal’s first entry into Oman to drive the development of the property market and support the growth of Oman’s real-estate sector in accordance with Oman Vision 2040. The value of the investment in the project from both parties will reach SR6 billion, and it will be developed in three stages on an area of 3.5 million square metres. Through the partnership, DarGlobal will develop a mixed-use project in Yiti and Yankat areas, 20-minutes from Downtown Muscat, a paradise with a distinctive terrain where the earthy atmosphere envelops as part of a large master development, situated 100m above the shores and overlooking of the Sea of Oman in Muscat, comprising of 3,500 residential units of medium-sized villas, townhouses, and low-rise apartments. A place where two charming hotels of 450 rooms, a plaza filled with cafes and restaurants, a gated promenade with luxury retail and other amenities. Ziad El Chaar, Vice Chairman of DarGlobal Properties, said , “We are excited to become part of this unique project”. Oman has always offered an exceptional experience for residents and tourists, and the development of Yiti and Yankat areas will further elevate the nation’s offering and position it as a world-class destination. Our project in Oman builds on DarGlobal’s strategic aspirations of elevating the standards and quality of the real-estate sector in the region. But most importantly, with this project, we’re working to ensure a sustainable and environmentally friendly approach to building a large, mixed-use development that fits in with the characteristics of the area. AIDA sits atop one of the world’s highest peaks, a place where all the noise is quietened, composing a beautiful symphony. Overlooking one of the most breathtaking horizons in the world will lie a place bubbling with inspiration.” Hashil Bin Obaid Al Mahrouqi, CEO of OMRAN Group, said: “We are delighted to work with DarGlobal on this master project that is being developed with world class expertise. We believe they share the same vision with regards to balanced and sustainable building practices, and this is a critical factor in the success of this project. The project is strategically designed as an extension to Muscat city to showcase the vision of progress and sustainable urbanisation. AIDA will become an attractive and sought-after destination with its many residential, entertainment, cultural, retail and recreational offerings that will put Oman on the regional and global tourism map, as well as drive foreign investment and stimulate key economic sectors that will help achieve Oman Vision 2040.” The project is one of the largest urban developments in Oman, extending to a total area of over 11 million square kilometres. The project masterplan was designed to ensure innovative standards in urban development and place-creation, and the adoption of architectural foundations in harmony with the rich natural surroundings. In line with the Sultanate’s ambitious plans for economic diversification, the project plays a pivotal role in increasing the contribution of the tourism sector to support the national GDP. Based on the position of OMRAN Group as the active national arm in the development of the tourism sector, the project will contribute to providing promising investment opportunities and creating a fertile environment to attract capital and foreign direct investment.

- Project marks DarGlobal’s entry into the growing Omani market
- AIDA is an ode to the glorious Sea of Oman and undisturbed nature, where high curvaceous cliffs flawlessly meet deep waters
_______________________
Dubai, UAE; March 24, 2022: DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia and the GCC, and Oman Tourism Development Company (OMRAN Group) – the executive arm of the Sultanate for tourism development, have signed an agreement recently at Expo 2020 Dubai to develop ‘AIDA’, one of the largest premium, mixed-use real estate projects located in the Yiti area in Muscat.
The project marks DarGlobal’s first entry into Oman to drive the development of the property market and support the growth of Oman’s real-estate sector in accordance with Oman Vision 2040. The value of the investment in the project from both parties will reach SR6 billion, and it will be developed in three stages on an area of 3.5 million square metres.
Through the partnership, DarGlobal will develop a mixed-use project in Yiti and Yankat areas, 20-minutes from Downtown Muscat, a paradise with a distinctive terrain where the earthy atmosphere envelops as part of a large master development, situated 100m above the shores and overlooking of the Sea of Oman in Muscat, comprising of 3,500 residential units of medium-sized villas, townhouses, and low-rise apartments. A place where two charming hotels of 450 rooms, a plaza filled with cafes and restaurants, a gated promenade with luxury retail and other amenities.
Ziad El Chaar, Vice Chairman of DarGlobal Properties, said, “We are excited to become part of this unique project”. Oman has always offered an exceptional experience for residents and tourists, and the development of Yiti and Yankat areas will further elevate the nation’s offering and position it as a world-class destination. Our project in Oman builds on DarGlobal’s strategic aspirations of elevating the standards and quality of the real-estate sector in the region. But most importantly, with this project, we’re working to ensure a sustainable and environmentally friendly approach to building a large, mixed-use development that fits in with the characteristics of the area. AIDA sits atop one of the world’s highest peaks, a place where all the noise is quietened, composing a beautiful symphony. Overlooking one of the most breathtaking horizons in the world will lie a place bubbling with inspiration.”
Hashil Bin Obaid Al Mahrouqi, CEO of OMRAN Group, said: “We are delighted to work with DarGlobal on this master project that is being developed with world class expertise. We believe they share the same vision with regards to balanced and sustainable building practices, and this is a critical factor in the success of this project. The project is strategically designed as an extension to Muscat city to showcase the vision of progress and sustainable urbanisation. AIDA will become an attractive and sought-after destination with its many residential, entertainment, cultural, retail and recreational offerings that will put Oman on the regional and global tourism map, as well as drive foreign investment and stimulate key economic sectors that will help achieve Oman Vision 2040.”
The project is one of the largest urban developments in Oman, extending to a total area of over 11 million square kilometres. The project masterplan was designed to ensure innovative standards in urban development and place-creation, and the adoption of architectural foundations in harmony with the rich natural surroundings.
In line with the Sultanate’s ambitious plans for economic diversification, the project plays a pivotal role in increasing the contribution of the tourism sector to support the national GDP. Based on the position of OMRAN Group as the active national arm in the development of the tourism sector, the project will contribute to providing promising investment opportunities and creating a fertile environment to attract capital and foreign direct investment.

DarGlobal and Qetaifan Projects unveil premium sea-front residences with interiors designed by ELIE SAAB at Expo 2020 Dubai
The Qatar Pavilion at Expo 2020 Dubai hosted the launch of the premium residential project that marks Saudi Arabia’s DarGlobal’s entry into the Qatari market Inspired by the sea and luxury island living, Les Vagues residences embody the sophisticated elegance of ELIE SAAB designs _______________________ Dubai, UAE; March 23, 2022: The Qatar Pavilion at Expo 2020 Dubai hosted the launch of Les Vagues residences by ELIE SAAB, a luxury residential project that’s being developed by DarGlobal, the leading real-estate company in Saudi Arabia, and Qetaifan Projects, a leading Qatari real estate development company fully owned by Katara Hospitality. The exclusive residences by the world-renowned designer reflect the sophisticated elegance and exceptional detailing that ELIE SAAB is recognised for in fashion and lifestyle, setting new standards for modern luxury living in Qatar. Taking inspiration from the unimaginable beauty and serenity of the sea, grand shores, and infinite horizons surrounding Qetaifan Island North, Les Vagues, which means waves in French, have been exquisitely designed as an ode to luxury island life with clean and contemporary lines softened by carefully selected palms and tropical foliage. Ziad El Chaar, Vice Chairman of DarGlobal Properties, said , “We’re extremely honored to be launching this prestigious project from Qatar’s Pavilion at Expo 2020 Dubai – it’s truly a significant moment as DarGlobal enters Qatar with a project that will set new standards for luxury living and affirms our commitment to the market. After our successful project launch with the master of design himself, Elie Saab, in Riyadh we’re collaborating for a second time on this premium residential project in one of the region’s most sought-after developments. Our project on Qetaifan Island North is unique and builds on the DarGlobal’s strategic aspirations of regional and global expansion through superior, high-quality real-estate projects that cater to discerning clientele from across the world.” Elie Saab Jr, CEO of ELIE SAAB Group, commented: “We are delighted to collaborate with DarGlobal and Qetaifan Projects on this premium residential project that is inspired by the natural beauty of the island and its magnificent surroundings. Les Vagues is a project that embodies architectural and lifestyle expression of our brand delivering exceptional and timeless experiences through luxury real-estate projects that are unmatched globally.” HE Sheikh Nasser Bin Abdulrahman Al-Thani, Managing Director, Qetaifan Projects, said: “Following our concerted efforts to provide the local market with international standards that work on developing and revitalizing sectors such as tourism, hospitality, entertainment and of course real estate development, we are happy to bring a new innovative project to Qatar. We’re looking forward to working with DarGlobal and ELIE SAAB, a global pioneer in design, on this premium project that is unlike any other in the region. Qetaifan Island North is being developed as the first touristic entertainment destination in Qatar, that will put the country on the regional and global tourism map, and Les Vagues residences is an integral project within the masterplan of the development.” Les Vagues feature opulent one, two and three-bedroom sea-front residencies with a variety of majestic balconies and terraces and floor-to ceiling windows for residents to enjoy uninterrupted panoramic views of the sea.  The interiors perfectly embody the beauty of ELIE SAAB’s designs, leaving a lasting impression of refined elegance and spectacular grace where shapes and colors blend harmoniously. Special attention has been given to the finishes with exquisite craftsmanship, exceptional level of quality and aesthetic appeal in pure ELIE SAAB style. The amenities at Les Vagues are tailored to the residents’ needs, featuring à la carte concierge services as well as a state-of-the-art fitness center, an infinity swimming pool, a landscaped community courtyard with sea views, a 24-hour reception desk, public areas furniture from ELIE SAAB Maison Collection, luxury retail outlets, and parking for all residential units. DarGlobal and Qetaifan Projects signed the agreement to develop a premium residential and lifestyle project on Qetaifan Island North last October. The project marks DarGlobal’s first entry into Qatar with the aim of driving the development of the luxury property market and support the growth of Qatar’s real-estate sector. Work on the development will start in Q2 2022, and total sales are expected to reach over 1 billion Qatari Riyal. Qetaifan Island North is emerging as a thriving waterfront hub representing a new, modern lifestyle. Inspired by the rich culture and nature of the region, the distinct island will feature a thrilling waterpark, a luxurious hotel, unrivalled accommodation, exceptional retail options, and world class facilities that make it a vibrant and attractive community. The island is also a symbol of the vision, insight, and aspiration to develop into an internationally acclaimed and recognised landmark location and Qatar’s future iconic destination.

title: DAR Al Arkan Reveals W Residences Dubai Downtown
content:
DAR Al Arkan unveils W Residences Dubai Downtown, offering stunning views of Burj Khalifa and Dubai Fountain.
DarGlobal reveals W Residences Dubai – Downtown overlooking Dubai’s Burj Khalifa and Dubai Fountain
Worth 1 billion AED, The W Residences Dubai – Downtown brings elegant, prominently positioned homes with access to luxury amenities Residents can step into the heart of the action, and back into their private world at the W Residences Dubai – Downtown Limited number of 384 exclusive units with stunning views of Downtown Dubai _______________________ Riyadh, KSA; February 25, 2022: DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, has unveiled the W Residences Dubai – Downtown in the bustling heart of Dubai, offering hotel-inspired living at one of the most sought-after addresses in the world. The 1 billion AED development is anticipated to mark the first standalone residences in the world under the iconic lifestyle W Hotels brand. W Residences Dubai – Downtown, which will be managed by Marriott International is situated in the prestigious Downtown Dubai with uninterrupted, spectacular views of Burj Khalifa, the tallest man-made structure in the world, The Dubai Fountain, Dubai Opera and Old Town Dubai. The tower is in close proximity to the many premium and world-famous lifestyle destinations that the city has to offer. Stepping away from the action-packed city, residents enter their own oasis of exclusivity and private space with beautifully crafted interiors, exquisite finishes, the finest services and exceptional amenities. Each residence has a unique design and purposeful layout that ensures each home is spacious, elegant and appeals to the needs of discerning clientele. Construction of The W Residences Dubai – Downtown is currently underway and is estimated to be completed by December 2025. Ziad El Chaar, Vice Chairman of DarGlobal Properties, said: “Our experience in delivering high-end co-branded homes with global brands like Elie Saab, Versace, Roberto Cavalli, Pagani and Missoni puts us in a unique position to always bring the best, most desirable residential spaces to our customers. The W Residences Dubai – Downtown sets a new standard for extraordinary hotel living in the heart of a bustling city like Dubai catering to clientele who like to be close to the action but have their own luxurious private space close by. The Residences’ architecture, interiors and amenities is a truly what makes it a distinct, stand out tower in the midst of many other high-rises. This our third project in the Downtown Dubai area and I believe it’s a unique and fulfilling location to own your dream home.” Jaidev Menezes, Vice President, Mixed-Use Development – Europe, Middle East & Africa, Marriott International commented: “We are delighted to work with DarGlobal to launch this residential development under the W brand. With its vibrant design and impeccable service, W Residences Dubai – Downtown will be a great fit in Dubai’s iconic Downtown district.” The architecturally stunning tower consists of a limited number of 384 exclusive, high-end residences with state-of-the-art appliances and fittings to compliment the exquisite interiors and give residents modern, functional, and elegantly appointed homes. Additionally, short terms rentals are prohibited to preserve the tower’s standards, ensure greater comfort and exclusivity, and maintain a higher property valuation. Residents will live the W lifestyle at W Residences Dubai – Downtown which will offer luxury amenities dedicated to residents and their guests, turning every moment into a truly memorable experience. FUEL – the W brand’shigh-energy, social take on wellness will allow residents to focus on mind and body, will be complemented by an infinity outdoor swimming pool with views of the iconic Burj Khalifa with an outdoor terrace that features a lounge and dining area, as well as the FIT Fitness Centre and a spa. The Residences will also feature the Living Room lounge – a modern take on the standard lobby. Residents will also have access to the W brand’s signature Whatever/Whenever® service which will provide residents with ultimate levels of convenience, round-the-clock in-Residence dining and catering services, laundry and dry cleaning, housekeeping, babysitting, fitness training and much more. Other amenities include a media room with a cinema, gaming equipment and a chill-out space; a coworking space, meeting rooms, and a clubhouse where new connections spark over signature cocktails or a gourmet lunch. The Residences are 20 mins away from Dubai International Airport, 10 minutes from the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) and a few minutes away from The Dubai Mall, one of the world’s largest shopping malls. Expanding the DarGlobal brand to international markets as a testament to the success of Saudi companies in delivering unique projects in new markets. The developer is the largest non-governmental developer in the Middle East with AED30 billion in assets and a track record of delivery since 1994. W Residences Dubai – Downtown is the developer’s third project in Dubai following the successful launches of Urban Oasis in collaboration with Missoni and Da Vinici Tower in collaboration with Pagani Automobili.

title: DarGlobal opens office in China in a bid to usher in global growth
content:
DarGlobal opens office in China in a bid to usher in global growth
Riyadh, KSA; February 5, 2022: DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, continues its dynamic growth momentum by announcing the opening of its office in Beijing, China. The announcement is in line with the DarGlobal’s strategic expansion and builds on spreading the leading Saudi Arabian brands globally. DarGlobal’s Beijing office will serve multiple functions to allow for joint ventures between DarGlobal and leading Chinese real estate developers for the Chinese and the Saudi market, further increasing and facilitate collaboration between Saudi Arabia and China and enhance investment and knowledge sharing opportunities. The office will primarily promote cooperation and partnerships within the real-estate and technology sectors to exchange and implement global best practices in these respective industries. DarGlobal recently appointed Guo Jiancheng as General Manager for DarGlobal’s office in Beijing to lead the company’s operations in China. Following the announcement Jiancheng commented: “Over its 27-year history in Saudi Arabia DarGlobal has pioneered a distinctive approach to development, introduced new technologies, and raised the benchmark for the real-estate and technology sectors in the Kingdom. With this expertise and industry know-how, the company is well-positioned to take this knowledge and creativity to a global level and promote it as best practice. By entering into the Chinese market, DarGlobal is also well positioned to enhance relations between the Kingdom and China across multiple fronts.” DarGlobal’s office will act as a hub to support Chinese companies and investors seeking expansion, company formation and investment opportunities in the Kingdom. By providing access to required information, permits, legal and financial knowledge, as well as support on partnerships and other requirements, DarGlobal is making entry into the Kingdom more accessible. Likewise, the office will support Saudi Arabian companies to explore expansion opportunities and gain entry into the Chinese market. title: DarGlobal teams with Pagani Automobili to unveil an ultra-exclusive residential tower in Dubai
content:
DarGlobal teams with Pagani Automobili to unveil an ultra-exclusive residential tower in Dubai
A tower whose interior design reflects the uniqueness and distinctive features of Pagani’s DNA, boldly taking its place among the most famous towers in the world in the heart of Downtown Dubai Overlooking the world’s largest building Burj Khalifa, the AED 800 million tower is an exclusive and radically designed masterpiece. _______________________ Dubai, UAE; December 15, 2021: DarGlobal , the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia and the GCC, has unveiled the DarGlobal Pagani Tower in Dubai in partnership with Italian Hypercar manufacturer Pagani Automobili, renowned for its exclusive and handcrafted production of ultra-limited-edition cars. The launch of the prestigious AED 800 million development marks significant milestones for both the companies: DarGlobal’s continued regional expansion by partnering with the world’s top luxury brands, and the world’s first ever Pagani-inspired exclusive spaces being launched along with the bespoke line of interior furniture, branded Pagani.  DarGlobal Pagani tower is situated in the heart of the city directly on the Dubai Water Canal, with close proximity to Downtown Dubai’s top attractions such as Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall and many other premium lifestyle locations. The tower offers spectacular and uninterrupted views of the Dubai Water Canal, making the building a true sculpted heaven within the bustling city.    Horacio Pagani, Founder & Chief Designer, Pagani Automobili S.p.A. said “We’re delighted to be working with DarGlobal on this project, our first in the region, and we’re excited to be designing the interiors of the incredible DarGlobal Pagani tower. The living spaces will offer exclusive, bespoke environments, reflecting the cornerstones of our creative philosophy that combines form and function to create unique, handmade objects. It’s a philosophy that has been transmitted to us through the work of Leonardo Da Vinci who we try, in our own small way, to honor every day and after whom we decided to name this tower. The Dubai real estate sector continues to grow immensely and we’re proud of being a part of an exclusive and truly one-of-a-kind development plan that has so much to offer.”  Ziad El Chaar, Vice Chairman of DarGlobal Properties, said: “DarGlobal is proud to collaborate with exclusive partners that help us build the ultimate spaces that awaken the senses in different ways. While we’re paying the utmost attention to creating beautiful living spaces, with the finest details, and unmatched quality; we’re also delivering the most spacious units in the Dubai market with two-bedroom apartments starting at 2100 sq. ft. up to a 7000 sq. ft. penthouse. A unique design and an ultimate sensory experience, the tower construction is currently underway and is set to be completed before mid-2023.This is a project that will match One Hyde Park of London in terms of quality and detailing.” The stunning DarGlobal Pagani tower in collaboration with Pagani is one of the best representations of Italian and contemporary design excellence around the world. The tower consists of high-end one, two and three-bedroom apartments and a super luxurious penthouse shaped as a globe with exquisite interiors tailored by Pagani.    The unique apartments, fully fitted with luxury décor elements that epitomize the Pagani style, come in varying sizes and offering unique levels of five-star living, breathtaking views of Dubai, and impressive common areas, all fitted with a fully equipped gymnasium, swimming pool, and a magnificent sky garden, all crafted with premium material and designed with the utmost attention to detail.   Residents will have access to additional luxury facilities and services. The tower features a grand lobby with 24/7 concierge and security services. Expanding the DarGlobal brand to international markets is a testament to the success of Saudi companies in delivering unique projects in new markets. It comes at an opportune time with Expo 2020 which started in October 2021, which will underline the investment potential in Dubai.

title: DarGlobal teams with Missoni to deliver the exclusive Urban Oasis water-front residential tower in Dubai
content:
DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, has unveiled the Urban Oasis residential tower in Dubai in partnership with the luxury Italian fashion house, Missoni, known for its bold colours and iconic zigzag motifs, stripes, and wave patterns.
DarGlobal teams with Missoni to deliver the exclusive Urban Oasis water-front residential tower in Dubai
Urban Oasis by Missoni brings the Missoni lifestyle and Miami vibes to the city The AED 800 million tower is situated in the heart of the city on the Dubai Water Canal _______________________ Riyadh, KSA; October 6, 2021: DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, has unveiled the Urban Oasis residential tower in Dubai in partnership with the luxury Italian fashion house, Missoni, known for its bold colours and iconic zigzag motifs, stripes, and wave patterns. The launch of the prestigious AED 800 million development marks two significant firsts for both the companies: DarGlobal’s regional expansion with its first project in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), and the Arab world’s first ever bespoke Missoni-inspired living spaces designed by the fashion brand’s MissoniHome line dedicated to interiors, decor, and furnishings. Urban Oasis is situated in the heart of the city directly on the Dubai Water Canal in close proximity to Downtown Dubai’s top attractions such as Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall, and many other premium lifestyle locations. The deluxe homes of Urban Oasis offer spectacular and uninterrupted views of the Dubai Water Canal, making the tower a true urban oasis within the bustling city. Construction of the tower is currently underway and is set to be completed before the end of 2023. Ziad El Chaar, Vice Chairman of DarGlobal Real Estate Development Company, said: “The project’s location is in one of the most sought-after in the city, and we’re happy to have our first flagship development in the UAE situated in the heart of Dubai. The Dubai Water Canal is one of Dubai’s most attractive areas for homebuyers, and given its proximity to Downtown Dubai, Urban Oasis assures the best that the city life can offer, making it the ideal place to live. Working with Missoni is a clear indication of our continued dedication to providing our clients and investors with the highest standards of luxury living, while being completely unique compared to anything else on the market.” Livio Proli, CEO, Missoni, said: “We’re delighted to be working with DarGlobal on the Urban Oasis project, our first in the region, and are excited to be furnishing these incredible apartments with the finest fabrics and Miami inspired design, which will give the homes a unique and original finish. Our creative team has come together to design bespoke luxury interiors that perfectly complement the apartment’s urban surroundings. The Dubai real estate sector continues to grow and we’re relishing being a part of a development that has so much to offer.” The stunning Urban Oasis in collaboration with Missoni is one of the best representatives of Italian fashion and contemporary design excellence around the world. It consists of 38 floors of high-end one, two and three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom penthouses with luxury interiors from MissoniHome. The unique penthouse apartments, which are accessible via a private elevator, come fully fitted with high-end Missoni fixtures and décor elements. The immaculately designed one, two, three apartments come in varying sizes and offer unique levels of five-star living, increadible water-front views and a closed kitchen. Residents will also have access to luxury facilities and services. The tower features a swimming pool, a children’s play area, car parking, an equipped gymnasium, and 24/7 conceirge and security service. Expanding the DarGlobal brand to international markets as a testament to the success of Saudi companies in delivering unique projects in new markets. It comes at an opportune time with Expo 2020 starting in October 2021, which will underline the investment potential in Dubai.

Brand equity drives desirability, rental performance, resale value, and long-term appreciation. A branded residence is not just a property — it’s a global asset backed by decades of reputation.

DarGlobal continues to expand through new partnerships across the GCC, Europe, and Asia. Speak with our advisors to register for upcoming launches and exclusive early access.

Choose your preferred development and reserve your unit through our global sales team. International and remote investors can complete the entire process digitally with full transparency.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the first and only Trump-branded development in the Middle East, delivered by DarGlobal. It combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in a single address on Sheikh Zayed Road, with direct access to Downtown Dubai.
What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
The Trump Residences offer one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, ranging from 109 to 722 sqm. Every unit is positioned to deliver a guaranteed view of either the Arabian Sea or the Burj Khalifa.
When will Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai be completed?
The project is under development with handover scheduled for December 2031. DarGlobal is the master developer. Buyers purchasing off-plan should contact the DarGlobal sales team directly for current payment plan terms and availability.
Where exactly is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai located?
The tower sits on Sheikh Zayed Road at the gateway to Downtown Dubai, giving residents direct access to Dubai Mall, the Dubai Fountains, and the Burj Khalifa district while bypassing the congestion of central Downtown.
Does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai have the world's highest pool?
Yes. The development features the highest outdoor infinity pool in the world, reserved exclusively for residents of the Trump Residences. The rooftop pool overlooks the full Dubai skyline and is one of the project's defining headline amenities.
What is the Trump Members-Only Club?
The Trump Members-Only Club is a private club within the tower, accessible by annual membership fee with residents receiving priority access. It includes a signature bar, cigar lounge, golf simulator, spa treatment rooms, meeting rooms, and a dedicated pool.
What amenities are exclusive to residents of the Trump Residences?
Residents have exclusive access to the world's highest rooftop infinity pool, a state-of-the-art gym, an owners lounge, and a children's play area. Membership to the Trump Members-Only Club is available separately for access to the wider lifestyle facilities within the building.
Is Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai a good investment?
The project sits in one of Dubai's highest-demand corridors, combining a globally recognised brand, a world-record amenity, and direct Downtown proximity. Branded residences in Dubai have historically commanded rental premiums over comparable unbranded units; buyers should seek independent advice on investment suitability.
How does Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai differ from other luxury towers in Dubai?
It is the only development in the Middle East to combine a Trump five-star hotel, a residents-only world-record infinity pool, and a private members club under one address. The hotel-residential structure gives owners access to hotel-grade services alongside private ownership.
How do I register interest or enquire about buying at Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?
Prospective buyers can register interest, download the project brochure, or book a private viewing through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can confirm current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

What is Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
Marriott Residences Aida, Oman is a fully furnished branded apartment complex at AIDA, Muscat. The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which uses the Marriott name under license from Marriott International. Residences come with à la carte hotel-style services and are designed to deliver the comfort and standard associated with the Marriott brand.
Who developed Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
The project is developed by Dar Al Arkan Property Development SPC, which operates the Marriott brand name under a licensing agreement with Marriott International, Inc. Marriott Residences Aida, Oman are not owned, developed, or sold by Marriott International or its affiliates.
What unit types and sizes are available?
The development offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom fully furnished apartments ranging from 60 to 194 sqm. Each residence is designed with contemporary decor and thoughtfully furnished to offer stylish, comfortable living with seamless integration across all spaces.
What services do residents receive at Marriott Residences?
Residents benefit from à la carte services styled around the Marriott standard, including a dedicated concierge, 24-hour reception desk, doorman, lobby, and valet. The service model is designed to bring hotel-quality living to private residential ownership at the AIDA estate.
What amenities does AIDA offer for Marriott Residences owners?
The AIDA estate provides a championship golf course, swimming pools, a private beach enclave, children's splash areas, wellness centres, fitness centre, plazas, cafes and restaurants, hiking trails, mountain bike trails, running trail, promenades, viewing decks, parks, a clubhouse, outdoor landscapes, and access to nearby 5-star hotels including Nikki Beach, Al Bustan Palace Ritz-Carlton, Shangri-La, and Jumeirah Muscat Bay.
When will Marriott Residences Aida, Oman be completed?
Completion is expected in September 2029. The development is currently under construction. Contact DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk to register interest, book a unit, or download the project brochure.
Can foreign nationals buy property at Marriott Residences Aida, Oman?
Yes. Oman offers 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities on qualifying Integrated Tourism Complex (ITC) properties. Buyers on ITC-registered projects are eligible for a lifetime residency visa. An exclusive mortgage program is also available in Oman for both resident and non-resident buyers.
What are the tax advantages of investing in Oman?
Oman applies 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax, and 0% inheritance tax, with inheritance assessed under the investor's own country's laws rather than local law. Businesses in special economic and free zones benefit from a 25-year exemption from corporate income taxes.
Why invest in Muscat real estate now?
Oman ranked 7th globally and 1st in Asia and the Arab world in the Numbeo Quality of Life Index in 2023, and is one of the safest countries worldwide. The country targets over $22.5 billion per year from tourism by 2040. The Saudi-Oman Highway cuts travel time by 16 hours between the two countries, and an upcoming railway project connecting the UAE to Muscat will further strengthen regional connectivity and investment appeal.
How does Marriott Residences relate to the wider AIDA development?
Marriott Residences is one of several residential products within the AIDA estate in Muscat. Other DarGlobal projects at AIDA include Trump International Hotel Oman, Trump Golf Villas, The Great Escape 2, and Sunrise Haven. Together they form a multi-branded, fully integrated resort community 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera.

What is Trump International Hotel Oman?
Trump International Hotel Oman is a luxury hotel at AIDA, Muscat, where investors purchase freehold ownership of individual rooms or suites. The hotel is managed by Trump Hotels, and owners earn a share of revenue from guest bookings while receiving two weeks of complimentary personal use each year.
What does owning a hotel room at Trump International Hotel Oman mean?
Owners hold freehold title to a specific room or suite within the hotel. Trump Hotels manages the property professionally, generating rental income from guest bookings. Owners receive a share of that revenue and retain two weeks annually for personal use, giving a tangible asset with managed returns.
What unit types and sizes are available at Trump International Hotel Oman?

What are the benefits of hotel room ownership versus residential investment?
Hotel room ownership generates passive income from guest bookings, comes with full Trump Hotels professional management, and includes two weeks of complimentary personal use per year. Owners hold freehold title to a tangible hospitality asset without the management burden of private rental.

title: DarGlobal Blog | Insights on Luxury Real Estate, Investments
content:
Explore the DarGlobal blog for expert insights on luxury real estate, global investment trends, and exclusive lifestyle content.
Top Features High-Net-Worth Buyers Look For
The definition of prestige in real estate has undergone a fundamental transformation. While opulent finishes and prime addresses remain prerequisites, today's HNWI (High-Net-Worth Individual) buyer views a residence as an extension of their personal values, wellness philosophy, and security requirements. To appeal to modern affluent buyers, developers and sellers must look beyond cosmetic grandeur. The most sought-after luxury home features combine privacy, architectural purpose, advanced technology, and curated lifestyle amenities. 1. Advanced Privacy and Discreet Security Systems For ultra-affluent buyers, personal privacy and security are non-negotiable foundations. Modern security infrastructure extends far beyond standard alarm systems or perimeter fencing: Biometric and AI Access Control: Facial recognition, keyless entry systems, and automated license plate readers ensure seamless yet tightly monitored access. Dedicated Security Suites: On-site guard quarters, subterranean safe rooms, and independent power microgrids offer continuous protection during emergencies. Acoustic and Architectural Shielding: Strategic landscaping, deep setbacks, and soundproof glazing safeguard residential privacy from public sightlines and urban noise. 2. Integrated Health and Longevity Amenities Wellness has shifted from an occasional indulgence to a daily lifestyle priority. The contemporary HNWI buyer expects sanctuary-grade health facilities built directly into their home: Medical-Grade Environmental Controls: Advanced indoor air purification, oxygen-enriched sleeping quarters, and multi-stage water filtration systems maintain optimal indoor health standards. Recovery and Spa Suites: Dedicated wellness wings featuring cryotherapy chambers, infrared saunas, cold plunge pools, and red-light therapy rooms cater to physical recovery and performance. Biophilic Architectural Design: Indoor gardens, natural light optimization, and living walls help reduce stress and enhance psychological well-being. 3. Experiential Entertaining and Collection Showcases Luxury homes are designed to serve as backdrop spaces for social entertaining and private collections. Rather than standard reception rooms, affluent buyers look for specialized lifestyle environments: Sommelier-Grade Wine Vaults: Temperature- and humidity-controlled cellars equipped with digital inventory tracking systems showcase rare vintages. Automotive Galleries: Climate-controlled, showroom-style garages equipped with vehicle lifts allow collectors to display classic and exotic cars as functional art. Culinary Prep Kitchens: Dual-kitchen layouts pair a polished open-concept main kitchen with a secondary heavy-prep scullery, allowing professional catering teams to operate out of sight during events. 4. Resort-Style Outdoor Living Spaces Extending primary living zones into the outdoors expands usable square footage and creates a vacation-like atmosphere at home. Popular outdoor luxury home features include: Infinity Edge Pools and Cabanas: Temperature-controlled swimming pools equipped with underwater sound systems, private cabanas, and integrated spa features. Outdoor Culinary Stations: Fully equipped outdoor kitchens featuring built-in wood-fired pizza ovens, professional rotisseries, and climate-controlled bar areas. Secluded Leisure Grounds: Private putting greens, pickleball courts, and fire lounges offer year-round outdoor recreation options. 5. Intuitive Smart Home Infrastructure Technology should simplify daily life without feeling overly complex. Today's buyers prefer invisible, intuitive automation systems over complicated user interfaces: Unified Home Automation: Centralized platforms manage climate, motorized shades, architectural lighting scenes, and audio-visual setups across the entire estate. Sustainable Energy Storage: Solar energy roofing integrated with battery storage arrays and geothermal heating ensures energy self-sufficiency and operational efficiency. Dedicated Remote Workspaces: Soundproof executive suites equipped with commercial-grade telecommunications infrastructure support global business management from home.   Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) 1. What is the single most important feature for an HNWI buyer when evaluating a property? Uncompromising privacy and location. While amenities can be added or updated, an estate's physical location, micro-climate, sightline protections, and neighborhood security cannot be replicated. 2. How are wellness features changing the design of luxury properties? Wellness amenities have evolved from standard home gyms to fully integrated spa and recovery suites. Buyers now look for medical-grade air and water filtration, circadian lighting systems, cold plunges, and dedicated recovery spaces. 3. Do sustainable and green features appeal to high-net-worth buyers? Yes. Sustainable luxury features such as solar generation, battery storage, smart glass windows, and geothermal systems offer energy independence, lower environmental impact, and long-term cost efficiency. 4. Why are dual kitchens becoming a standard in luxury home design? Dual kitchens allow the primary kitchen to serve as a clean, stylish gathering area for family and guests, while a fully equipped secondary prep kitchen handles heavy cooking and event catering behind closed doors. 5. How important is smart home technology in high-end real estate? Smart home technology is essential, but implementation matters. Today's luxury buyers prefer intuitive, centralized automation systems that quietly manage lighting, security, climate, and energy efficiency without requiring complex manual inputs.
The definition of prestige in real estate has undergone a fundamental transformation. While opulent finishes and prime addresses remain prerequisites, today's HNWI (High-Net-Worth Individual) buyer views a residence as an extension of their personal values, wellness philosophy, and security requirements.
Future of Branded Residences
The global real estate landscape is undergoing a monumental shift, with the market for high-end branded developments expanding at unprecedented speeds. Crossing beyond traditional hotel-operated apartments, the next generation of property projects blends hospitality, architectural prestige, and lifestyle curation to redefine the concept of luxury living. For investors, high-net-worth buyers, and leading global developers, understanding where this sector is heading reveals how prime residential assets will generate value over the coming decade. The Evolution Beyond Traditional Hotel Brands While the early era of branded residences was dominated almost exclusively by major hotel chains, the future belongs to diverse cross-industry partnerships. Non-hospitality brands are reshaping the market by translating their design language, prestige, and customer loyalty into physical residential spaces. Automotive and Supercar Brands: Residences developed in partnership with legendary car manufacturers offer private car lifts directly into sky garages, aerodynamic architecture, and bespoke interior engineering. Fashion and High-Jewelry Houses: Couture brands are curating full residential towers, infusing custom furniture lines, textiles, and signature aesthetics into living spaces. Gastronomy and Lifestyle Clubs: Emerging developments are partnering with Michelin-starred chefs, private members' clubs, and wellness institutions to build communities centered around exclusive social access. Key Drivers Shaping the Next Era of Luxury Living As global buyer demographics evolve, the expectations surrounding branded properties are shifting toward holistic experiences, technology integration, and environmental responsibility. 1. The Wellness Revolution and Medical Technology Future-proof residential towers are moving far beyond basic gym facilities and standard spas. Modern luxury living developments incorporate advanced longevity and health infrastructure directly into the building design: Circadian rhythm lighting systems and medical-grade air filtration throughout all units. Capital Growth vs Rental Yield in Luxury Real Estate
When building a high-value real estate portfolio, evaluating the trade-offs between  capital growth and rental yield stands as one of the most critical steps in strategy development. Both metrics serve distinct roles in wealth generation, but in the luxury segment, they behave differently than in mass-market residential property. Understanding how to balance long-term appreciation with immediate cash generation allows investors to optimize their total  returns while managing risk across market cycles. Defining Capital Growth and Rental Yield To construct an effective portfolio strategy, it is necessary to first separate how these two metrics generate financial value. Capital Growth refers to the increase in a property’s market value over time. It represents the equity built between the original purchase price and the appreciated market value. In luxury real estate, capital appreciation is typically driven by geographic scarcity, architectural prestige, prime locations, and long-term infrastructure developments. Rental Yield measures the annual income generated by a property as a percentage of its total purchase price or current market value. Gross yield calculates total annual rent against property price, whereas net yield factors in holding costs such as service fees, property management, insurance, and maintenance. The Dynamics of Luxury Real Estate Returns In standard residential housing, investors can often find properties that offer high rental yields. However, the luxury real estate sector operates under unique market dynamics where capital appreciation and yield often move in opposite directions. The Capital Growth Advantage in Prime Markets Luxury properties in world-class metropolitan hubs and exclusive coastal resorts are engineered primarily for capital appreciation. Ultra-high-net-worth buyers purchase these homes for their status, architectural uniqueness, and prime addresses—factors that remain permanently scarce. Asset Preservation: High-end homes act as strong capital preservation vehicles during inflationary periods. Equity Leverage: Substantial equity growth allows investors to borrow against accumulated value to acquire additional real estate assets. Compounding Value: Over an extended holding period, a modest annual appreciation percentage on a multi-million-dollar property translates to massive absolute financial gains. Because purchase prices for luxury estates are exceptionally high, the corresponding rental yield percentage often appears lower compared to entry-level housing. Investors who prioritize capital growth accept lower short-term rental yields in exchange for substantial wealth accumulation at resale. The Role of Rental Yield in Luxury Assets While luxury properties typically deliver lower yield percentages (often ranging between 3% and 5% net), the absolute cash flow generated in nominal currency remains significant due to high rental rates. Cash Flow Stability: Steady rental income helps cover ongoing holding costs, HOA fees, property taxes, and maintenance expenses. Risk Mitigation: Positive yields provide a financial buffer during broader economic downturns or periods when capital appreciation slows. Short-Term Luxury Rentals: Premium beachfront villas and branded residences often achieve higher yield figures by tapping into the high-end short-term vacation market. Evaluating Capital Growth vs Rental Yield To understand which focus aligns best with your portfolio, it helps to examine how each approach functions across key metrics: Primary Objective: Capital growth focuses on long-term equity accumulation, whereas rental yield focuses on immediate operational cash flow. Holding Horizon: Growth-oriented assets deliver their highest overall  returns over medium to long timeframes (7 to 10+ years). Yield-focused assets provide immediate monthly liquidity. Market Dynamics: Capital growth is heavily concentrated in prime urban centers and exclusive waterfront enclaves. Yield opportunities are frequently found in emerging districts, commercial luxury spaces, or high-density holiday destinations. Management Requirements: High-yield luxury assets—especially short-term rentals—demand active management, frequent upkeep, and tenant sourcing. Prime buy-and-hold residential estates require less operational oversight. Selecting the Right Strategy for Your Portfolio Choosing between a growth-focused strategy and a yield-focused strategy depends on your financial timeline, risk tolerance, and liquidity requirements. When to Prioritize Capital Growth A capital-growth-centric strategy is ideal if your primary goal is long-term generational wealth creation. Investors with strong outside liquidity can easily absorb ongoing maintenance costs and hold prime assets through market fluctuations. If you are investing in established blue-chip locations with fixed land supply, focusing on long-term value appreciation will generally yield superior long-term results. When to Prioritize Rental Yield A yield-centric strategy suits investors who require steady liquidity to service leverage or cover ongoing lifestyle expenses. If you are looking to create a self-sustaining real estate portfolio where rental income pays off development debts, prioritizing higher yields ensures your assets carry themselves without requiring ongoing cash infusions. Achieving a Balanced Hybrid Approach The most sophisticated real estate portfolios do not treat  capital growth vs rental yield as an either-or choice. Instead, experienced investors blend both approaches to maximize total  returns . Strategic Location Pairing: Hold trophy properties in established prime locations for long-term equity growth, complemented by modern luxury apartments in high-demand business districts for higher rental yields. Off-Plan Property Acquisitions: Purchasing high-end off-plan units at early launch prices allows investors to capture capital growth during the construction phase, followed by immediate rental yield once the building is completed. Value-Add Renovations: Acquiring older luxury properties in prime addresses and modernizing them can simultaneously boost the asset's overall market valuation and command higher ongoing rental rates.   FAQs 1. What is a good rental yield for a luxury real estate property? In prime luxury markets, net rental yields typically range between 3% and 5%. While this percentage is lower than entry-level housing, the high purchase price translates to substantial absolute cash income. 2. Why do luxury properties often have lower rental yields than standard properties? Luxury property prices appreciate at a rate that outpaces proportional rent increases. Because buyers pay a premium for status, views, and exclusive locations, the purchase price increases faster than the rental rate tenants are willing to pay. 3. Can a luxury property deliver high capital growth and high rental yield simultaneously? While rare, acquiring early-phase off-plan properties in high-demand emerging districts or executing extensive value-add renovations on underperforming luxury estates can deliver both strong equity growth and attractive rental yields. 4. Luxury assets carry higher holding expenses, including luxury HOA fees, concierge services, specialized insurance, and premium property maintenance. Historically, capital growth delivers significantly higher total financial returns over a 10-year horizon in the luxury sector. The compounding value of prime real estate appreciation generally outweighs the cumulative net rental income earned over the same timeframe.

What is a Dubai Off-Plan Property? Why Invest in Dubai Off-Plan Property? Investing in an  off-plan project in Dubai offers distinct financial advantages over buying completed, ready-to-move-in real estate. 1. Capital Appreciation Before Completion One of the most appealing drivers of buying  off-plan is the opportunity for early equity growth. Developers typically offer launch prices at a discount. Investors who buy at the initial launch often secure notable capital appreciation by the time handover occurs. 2. Flexible and Interest-Free Payment Plans Unlike ready properties that require an immediate down payment of 20% to 25% alongside a full mortgage or cash payout, a  Dubai off-plan property comes with developer-backed payment schedules. Common structures include: Construction-Linked Plans: Payments spaced out over construction milestones (e.g., 10% on booking, 60% during construction, 30% on handover). Post-Handover Payment Plans: Allowing buyers to pay a remaining percentage of the property price over 2 to 5 years  after taking possession. This enables investors to fund payments using rental yield generated by the property. 3. Lower Initial Capital Requirements Because initial down payments generally range from 10% to 20%, the barrier to entry for a  Dubai off-plan property is much lower than for ready properties. This allows investors to diversify their capital across multiple units or enter premium master-planned communities without locking up massive upfront liquidity. 4. Brand New Units with Modern Amenities Developments launched today feature modern architectural trends, energy-efficient designs, smart home technology, and top-tier community amenities. Key Regulatory Protections for Investors in Dubai Historically, buyers in global markets worried about developer default or completion delays. However, Dubai has established a comprehensive regulatory ecosystem through the  Dubai Land Department (DLD) and the  Real Estate Regulatory Agency (RERA) to safeguard investor capital. Mandatory Escrow Accounts: Developers are legally required to set up a dedicated escrow account for every  off-plan project. All buyer payments are deposited into this account, controlled by an approved financial institution. Milestone-Based Releases: Funds are released to the developer only when independent inspectors confirm specific construction milestones have been achieved. Project Registration Verification: Every legitimate project and developer receives an official registration number from RERA. Investors can verify these details online through the official  Dubai REST mobile application. Step-by-Step Process: How to Buy an Off-Plan Property in Dubai Purchasing an  off-plan home in Dubai is straightforward, transparent, and can often be completed remotely by international buyers. STEP 1 : Define Goals & Budget (Select location, yield target, and timeline) STEP 2 : Select Developer & Unit (Evaluate track record and reserve unit with EOI) STEP 3 : Sign Booking Form & Pay Down Payment (Pay 10%-20% reservation fee) STEP 4 : Sign Sales & Purchase Agreement (SPA) & Pay DLD Fee (4% registration fee) STEP 5 : Follow Construction Milestones & Complete Handover Inspection Research and Financial Planning: Determine your investment objective—are you seeking immediate capital gains via resale before completion, or long-term rental income? Set a clear budget including extra costs like the 4% DLD registration fee. Developer Due Diligence: Select a reputable developer with a proven track record of timely deliveries and high-quality build finishes. Unit Selection & Reservation: Submit an Expression of Interest (EOI) and reserve your preferred floor layout and view with an initial deposit (typically AED 20,000 to 50,000). Sign SPA and Register Oqood: Sign the Sales and Purchase Agreement (SPA), which details the payment schedule, completion date, and specifications. The purchase is registered with RERA via an interim registration document called  Oqood . Milestone Payments: Make installments as construction reaches specified phases. Handover and Snagging: Upon completion, conduct a property inspection ("snagging") to fix any defects before making the final payment and accepting the keys. Important Considerations and Risks While buying a  Dubai off-plan property offers tremendous returns, smart investors actively manage potential risks: Completion Delays: Construction timelines can shift due to supply chain factors. Always build a buffer period into your financial strategy. Market Fluctuations: Market conditions can shift between purchase and handover. Ensure your strategy accounts for both short-term market cycles and long-term holds. Liquidity and Resale Rules: Developers often require buyers to pay a minimum threshold (typically 30% to 40% of the unit value) before allowing them to resell an  off-plan contract on the secondary market.   FAQs 1. Is buying a Dubai off-plan property safe for foreign investors?  Yes. Foreign buyers enjoy the same freehold ownership rights as UAE residents in designated freehold areas. Furthermore, investor funds are protected under strict RERA regulations, which mandate that payments be held in dedicated project escrow accounts and released only as construction milestones are met. 2. Can I sell my off-plan property before construction is completed?  Yes, selling before completion (commonly known as an off-plan assignment or resale) is legal and common in Dubai. However, developers usually require you to pay a specific percentage of the total property price (typically between 30% and 40%) before approving the transfer to a new buyer. 3. What additional fees are involved when buying off-plan in Dubai?  In addition to the property purchase price, buyers should budget for: Dubai Land Department (DLD) Fee: 4% of the property value. Oqood Registration Fee: Typically around AED 3,000 to AED 5,000. Administrative/Developer Fees: Minor processing fees charged by the developer during SPA execution. 4. What happens if a developer delays the project handover?  RERA permits standard grace periods (usually 12 months) for unforeseen construction delays. If a developer exceeds reasonable delays or defaults entirely, RERA intervenes to either assign a new contractor to complete the project or liquidate project assets held in escrow to refund investors.

Waterfront Property: Definition, Value & Investment Potential
Owning a house near the water was considered the ultimate goal of real estate. In fact, waterfront properties not only appeal with beautiful views but also convey an entirely different concept to the real estate market. They signify a rare investment with the potential for financial as well as lifestyle gains. Key Takeaways Waterfront real estates that are directly adjacent to water bodies with immediate shoreline access are known to have 30-150% higher prices than those of comparable inland properties. Among these, oceanfront properties are the ones that have the highest premiums (100%+), followed by lakefront (40-60%) and riverfront (25-40%) locations. The top investment destinations are the French Riviera, the Caribbean, Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah, Oman and Qatar, which are offering a strong potential for appreciation. There are some additional costs that buyers need to be aware of, such as elevated flood insurance, 1.5 to 2 times higher maintenance expenses, and increased property taxes. On the other hand, the investment benefits are, among others, consistent above market appreciation, a strong potential for rental income, and a hedge against inflation due to limited supply. What is Waterfront Property? Waterfront property refers to real estate that is situated right next to a water body and thus, has unmediated access to the shore. Such properties cover areas where living spaces or estates are located alongside seas, lakes, rivers, canals, or bays. The main factor that differentiates waterfront properties is the direct touch or contact with water, not merely seeing it from afar. Real waterfront properties have the privilege of a personal water connection, which can be through a beach, a pier, or the direct shore. Such a difference dramatically affects the worth of the property as well as the owner's way of life. Types of Waterfront Properties Oceanfront Properties: Those are the ones that are literally on the beach and have access to the beach, and they usually cost the most money. Lakefront Homes: Real estate surrounding clean and pure lakes that allow the owners to build docks for themselves and also enjoy the tranquillity of the waters. Riverfront Estates: Residences built on rivers that have views of running water and access to the water for navigation. Canalfront Properties: These are the ones that provide access to the waterway, as well as private boat slips. Waterfront Property Value Premium Analysis How much does waterfront add to property value?   Usually, waterfront properties will cost 30% to 150% more than equivalent non-waterfront properties, the main factors determining the difference being the location and the water type. Seaside properties are the ones that are the most expensive; their extra cost is, therefore, frequently double or even more than that of similar properties. In contrast, the value of a property exposed to a lake only rises by 40 to 60%, while a property on the bank of a river is worth 25 to 40% more. Waterfront Property Pricing and Cost Analysis How much does waterfront property cost? Prices can be very different at different places. For example, oceanfront properties in luxury markets can cost anywhere between $2 million and more than $50 million, whereas lakefront homes in the less expensive areas may be available for half a million dollars. Understanding how much waterfront property is worth, it is necessary to look at the sales of similar properties, the quality of the water, and other factors related to the location. Popular Waterfront Property Locations Where to buy waterfront property   is decided by what you seek to achieve with your investment and your lifestyle preferences: Mediterranean Coast: Southern France, Italian Riviera, Greek Islands Caribbean Islands: Always attractive with lively rental markets U.S. Coastal Markets: Florida, California, Hamptons European Lakes:  Lake Como, Lake Geneva Dubai & Ras Al Khaimah: High-end developments with tax-free advantages and top-notch facilities Oman: Unspoiled coastlines with the development of luxury resort communities Qatar: Ultra-luxury waterfront developments in a rapidly expanding market There are also emerging markets in Southeast Asia and the Middle East that offer the potential for growth. Waterfront Property Investment Analysis Is buying waterfront property a good investment? In the past, waterfront real estate has been a major winner in value increase; most of the time, its growth rate is twice that of non-waterfront properties. The main benefits are: Continued value increase at a rate higher than the general market Good cash flow potential from rentals Protection against inflation by investing in real, tangible assets The luxury factor is keeping demand at a high level. It takes choosing the right market and understanding that you will have higher maintenance costs. Benefits and Lifestyle Advantages Homes with waterfronts are the best way to enjoy a lifestyle. With direct water access, it is easy to have fun swimming, boating, and fishing. The peaceful atmosphere helps one to be healthy; meanwhile, the unique communities give privacy and status. Such reasons are behind the steady desire for these properties; thus, they become a safe bet in terms of their value in the future. Insurance and Maintenance Considerations It is common for flood insurance to be mandatory, and the amount of money can be very large, particularly in the case of properties facing the ocean. In most cases, water damage is excluded from a standard policy; thus, a separate coverage is needed. The reasons behind these are saltwater corrosion as well as the high moisture content in the air. Plan to spend 1.5 to 2 times what you would spend on the maintenance of an inland property. Conclusion Waterfront real estate is a special example of the convergence of the sophisticated lifestyle, a luxurious trend, and investment opportunities. This trio of elements, limited supply, steady demand, and lifestyle attractiveness, ensures high profits for smart investors. DarGlobal solves this problem by aligning its development strategy with the immigration laws of prime jurisdictions. Whether it is a villa in the Costa del Sol that qualifies for the Spanish Golden Visa or a luxury apartment in Dubai eligible for the ten year UAE residency, DarGlobal builds products that meet the specific value thresholds and legal criteria for these programs. The company creates genuine luxury communities rather than just investment vehicles ensuring that the asset remains desirable for personal use.
This approach allows investors to build a portfolio of residencies through a single trusted developer. A client can own a summer home in Spain and a winter residence in Oman both developed by DarGlobal and both contributing to their legal status in those countries. The engineering feat of suspending a community at this height allows for architectural designs that cantilever over the rock face providing residents with the sensation of floating above the ocean.
This elevation is not just an aesthetic choice, it is a functional luxury. It creates a natural barrier that ensures security and seclusion for the community. title: Top 7 Art Museums in Dubai | DarGlobal

Exploring Dubai’s Art Scene: The 7 Best Art Museums
Dubai, a city known for its architectural marvels and luxurious lifestyle, is also a burgeoning hub for art enthusiasts. The city’s vibrant art scene is reflected in its array of museums, each offering a unique perspective on regional and international art. Here’s a guide to the seven best art museums in Dubai that are a must-visit for art lovers. 1. Louvre Abu Dhabi While technically not in Dubai, the Louvre Abu Dhabi is a cultural beacon worth the short trip. This universal museum in the Arab world focuses on shared human stories across civilizations and cultures. Designed by Jean Nouvel, the museum’s architecture is a work of art in itself, with a mesmerizing dome that creates a rain of light effect. 2. Dubai Museum Housed in the Al Fahidi Fort, the Dubai Museum is a deep dive into the emirate’s rich history and culture. The museum showcases life in Dubai before the oil boom, offering insights into the local art and cultural heritage. It’s a perfect blend of historical and contemporary artistry. 3. Etihad Museum The Etihad Museum , with its stunning design resembling a manuscript, offers a glimpse into the United Arab Emirates’ formation. It’s a modern museum focusing on contemporary creations, featuring interactive pavilions where visitors can explore the UAE’s history through photos, films, and more. 4. Jameel Arts Centre As one of the contemporary art institutions in Dubai, Jameel Arts Centre is a platform for contemporary artists and cultural events. It hosts multiple galleries, a research library, and a garden of sculptures, making it a vibrant cultural destination. 5. Tashkeel Tashkeel is an independent resource for artists and designers living and working in the UAE. It offers studios, workshops, and a gallery space. The exhibitions here are dynamic, featuring everything from local to international works, across all mediums of visual art. 6. The Third Line The Third Line is a Dubai-based gallery that showcases contemporary Middle Eastern artists. With a focus on promoting local art and artists, the gallery often hosts thought-provoking exhibitions and is a key player in the local art scene. 7. Leila Heller Gallery Located in Alserkal Avenue, Leila Heller Gallery is known for its engagement with artists from the Middle East, Central Asia, Southeast Asia, and Turkey. The gallery hosts a variety of exhibitions, often featuring large-scale installations and public projects.   In Dubai, the art scene is as diverse as the city itself, offering everything from historical insights to contemporary artistic expressions. These seven museums and galleries are just the beginning of what Dubai has to offer to art aficionados. Each visit promises a new perspective, showcasing why Dubai is rapidly becoming a global art destination.     Useful Links Luxury Villas in Spain to Buy A Luxurious Oasis Luxury Villas and Prime Real Estate   Redefining Luxury Hospitality

Five Types of Insurance Coverage Every Homeowner Needs
Owning a home is a significant achievement and a substantial investment that necessitates protection. As a homeowner, it’s crucial to understand the various types of insurance coverage available to safeguard your property and finances. Here are five essential types of insurance coverage every homeowner should consider: 1. Homeowners Insurance This is the most fundamental and necessary form of insurance for homeowners. It covers the structure of your home, your personal belongings, and liability protection in case someone is injured on your property. Homeowners insurance typically covers damage from fires, storms, theft, and other common hazards. However, it’s important to read the fine print, as certain natural disasters like floods and earthquakes are often not covered. 2. Flood Insurance Standard homeowners insurance policies do not cover flood damage. If your home is in a flood-prone area, flood insurance is indispensable. This insurance covers damage to your home’s structure and belongings due to flooding. The National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) and private insurers provide this coverage, which can be a lifesaver in safeguarding your investment against unpredictable natural disasters. 3. Earthquake Insurance Similar to flood insurance, earthquake insurance is a must-have if you live in an area prone to earthquakes. This coverage helps repair or rebuild your home and replace personal belongings in the event of an earthquake. Considering the devastating impact an earthquake can have, this insurance provides essential financial protection. 4. Umbrella Liability Insurance Umbrella liability insurance provides additional liability coverage beyond what your standard homeowners insurance offers. It protects your assets and future earnings in case you’re sued for damages that exceed the liability limits of your other insurance policies. It’s particularly valuable for homeowners with significant assets or potential exposure to liability claims. 5. Home Warranty or Home Repair Insurance While not traditional insurance, a home warranty or home repair insurance can be a wise investment. This coverage typically pays for the repair or replacement of major home systems and appliances that break down over time. It’s a practical way to manage unexpected repair costs and ensure that your home remains in good working order. In summary, while homeownership is a source of pride, it also comes with risks. By investing in the right insurance coverages, you can protect your home, belongings, and financial well-being against unforeseen events. Each homeowner’s needs are unique, so it’s advisable to consult with an insurance professional to tailor a package that suits your specific situation.

title: Staying Up-To-Speed on the Latest Residential Design Trends for 2024 - DarGlobal
